fi-hanke-df500404.s: The development and implementation of a system for responding to requests for a position report would require amendments to the law on facilitating the deployment of very high capacity networks, for which a government proposal is to be submitted to the Parliament of Finland during the spring session of 2025.
fi-hanke-df500404.t: As a law on location information for underground network infrastructure

fi-hanke-df82d063.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Waste Act, Part II 2023-2026 (improvement of competition neutrality)
fi-hanke-df82d063.s: The Waste Act makes the necessary changes to the provisions on competition neutrality in municipal waste management, taking into account the Government programme's entries on the clarification of secondary responsibility of municipalities and on the tightening of the exit limit.
fi-hanke-df82d063.t: Act amending the Waste Act, Part II 2023-2026 (Improving competition neutrality)

fi-hanke-e0203c27.f: Draft legislation by the Government to the Parliament of Finland supplementing the EU Gigabit Regulation
fi-hanke-e0203c27.s: The project implements the EU's so-called Gigabit Regulation (EU) 2024/1309 on measures to reduce the cost of the deployment of the gigabit-level electronic communications networks, amending Regulation (EU) 2015/2120 and repealing Directive 2014 / 61 / EU).
fi-hanke-e0203c27.t: Complementary legislation to the EU Gigabit Regulation

fi-hanke-e092e939.f: Government proposal to amend the Financial Stability Authority Act
fi-hanke-e092e939.s: The project will prepare a proposal from the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland, which will make the necessary changes to the law on the Financial Stability Authority and its Annex following the new EBA Guidelines on risk-based calculation of deposit guarantee payments in 2023.
fi-hanke-e092e939.t: amending the Financial Stability Authority Act

fi-hanke-e0ed1ec4.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to change the VAT Act (part 2 of the Digiaian VAT Act)
fi-hanke-e0ed1ec4.t: Act amending the VAT Act (part 2 of the Digia'

fi-hanke-e1f05cdd.f: Proposal of the Government to the Parliament of Finland supplementing the Government's proposal to amend the Law on the temporary support for the acquisition of an alternative propulsion vehicle and the conversion of a vehicle into an alternative propulsion vehicle
fi-hanke-e1f05cdd.s: The proposal would supplement the Government's proposal to amend the Procurement and Conversion Aid Act 1289/2021 in order to reflect the changing legal basis of EU State aid law, i.e. amendments to the de minimis Regulation.
fi-hanke-e1f05cdd.t: supplementing the Government's proposal to amend the law on the temporary support for the acquisition of an alternative propulsion vehicle and the conversion of a vehicle to an alternative propulsion vehicle

fi-hanke-e2a38768.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the organisation of development cooperation
fi-hanke-e2a38768.s: The proposal proposes to introduce a new law on the organisation of development cooperation, which brings together provisions on the organisation of the preparatory and implementation tasks of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs within and outside the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
fi-hanke-e2a38768.t: The law on the organisation of development cooperation

fi-hanke-e42e70f7.s: The project will implement the reform of the rules on criminal liability and implement the EU's so-called anti-corruption directive at national level.
fi-hanke-e42e70f7.t: Reform of the provisions on criminal liability and national implementation of the Anti-Corruption Directive

fi-hanke-e57d8e02.s: The Ministry of Education and Culture will appoint a working group to prepare measures to promote educational equality and positive special treatment in early childhood education, pre-primary and primary education.
fi-hanke-e57d8e02.t: Preparatory Working Party on Education and Training (PD- VOS) on the Right to Learn

fi-hanke-e86d46df.s: The aim of the project is to simplify and streamline maritime regulation, in particular the regulation of occupation and qualifications, and to promote the productivity of the Transport and Communications Agency.
fi-hanke-e86d46df.t: Legislative project to streamline maritime regulation

fi-hanke-e9910439.s: The proposal amends the Act on the participation of civil persons in crisis management and the Civil Service Act.
fi-hanke-e9910439.t: Revision of the regulation of annual leave in employment as provided for in the Civil Crisis Management Act

fi-hanke-e99fc249.f: Government proposal to promote renewable fuels in air transport
fi-hanke-e99fc249.s: The new law would provide for a national obligation to distribute air transport.
fi-hanke-e99fc249.t: Act on the promotion of renewable fuels in air transport

fi-hanke-ea57651a.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Act on the State Contribution of the Local Government to Basic Services and related laws
fi-hanke-ea57651a.s: reform the state-owned system of municipal basic services to ensure as far as possible the funding of municipal government-owned activities in the wake of the war reform and the TE- reform, which also aims at increasing the clarity and comprehensibility of the State-owned system;
fi-hanke-ea57651a.t: Act amending the Act on the State Contribution to Basic Services of the Municipality and related laws

fi-hanke-ecc01cff.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for the approval and entry into force of the Agreement on Air Transport with the Republic of Nicaragua
fi-hanke-ecc01cff.s: The agreement is a bilateral air transport agreement which, inter alia, provides for the possibility and conditions under which the parties may designate airlines to exercise the traffic rights conferred by the agreement, which provides for the rights and obligations of airlines in the exercise of their traffic.
fi-hanke-ecc01cff.t: Agreement on air transport with the Republic of Nicaragua

fi-hanke-ed4d9917.s: The project will draw up legislative proposals on the determination and allocation of the fee to be assigned to the authority responsible for the ex-ante guidance of the Agency.
fi-hanke-ed4d9917.t: Legislative project on charging for the task of ex-ante guidance and co-operation of the State Authorisation and Control Agency to be set up

fi-hanke-edfd34ed.s: It is proposed that a new discretionary employment service mission be set up to provide funding to associations and foundations for project activities aimed at promoting the general conditions for job search and employment for long-term unemployed people.
fi-hanke-edfd34ed.t: Development of employment services: Employment policy support

fi-hanke-ee743d27.s: The task of the working group is to prepare possible legislative changes to improve compliance with payment time legislation as objectives, in particular to strengthen the capacity of small and medium-sized enterprises.
fi-hanke-ee743d27.t: Improving compliance with payment time legislation

fi-hanke-f02153c7.f: Draft legislation by the Government supplementing the Regulations of the European Parliament and of the Council on the reform of the Visa Information System
fi-hanke-f02153c7.s: Preparation of national legislation supplementing the VIS amending Regulation (EU) 2021/1134.
fi-hanke-f02153c7.t: Complementary legislation to the European Parliament and Council Regulations on the reform of the Visa Information System

fi-hanke-f13c1583.s: The Convention contains obligations to criminalise, inter alia, the counterfeiting and provision of medicines and the placing on the market of medicinal products; it also contains provisions on criminal investigations and prosecution measures, as well as provisions on cooperation between authorities and international cooperation in criminal matters; it also contains provisions on the prevention of crime.
fi-hanke-f13c1583.t: Council of Europe Convention against Counterfeiting Medicinal Products

fi-hanke-f194c92f.f: Government proposal for the approval and entry into force of an agreement on the exchange of classified information and mutual protection with the OCCAR
fi-hanke-f194c92f.s: The proposal proposes that the Parliament of Finland adopt an agreement on the exchange of classified information and mutual protection with the Organisation for the Cooperation in the Armaments (OCCAR) and a law transposing the provisions of the Treaty.
fi-hanke-f194c92f.t: With a view to adopting and implementing an agreement on the exchange of classified information and mutual protection with the OCCAR

fi-hanke-f22cd269.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on the implementation and control of the obligations of the EU Regulation on the reduction of methane emissions from energy and on the amendment of the Electricity Market Act
fi-hanke-f22cd269.s: Regulation (EU) No 2024/1787 of the Safety and Chemicals Agency as the competent authority required by Regulation (EU) No 2024/1787 and the penalties provided for by that Regulation for the national regime.
fi-hanke-f22cd269.t: Law on the implementation and enforcement of the obligations of the EU Regulation on the reduction of methane emissions in the energy sector and on the amendment of the Electricity Market Act

fi-hanke-f2b6becb.f: Government proposal to amend the Act on the organisation of public ICT services
fi-hanke-f2b6becb.s: The Ministry of Finance has set up a working group to produce a proposal for legislative changes to the Tori Act.
fi-hanke-f2b6becb.t: Act amending the Act on the organisation of public ICT services

fi-hanke-f3c1de1a.s: Regulation (EU) 2026/1738 of the European Parliament and of the Council on the circular economy requirements for the design of vehicles and on the management of waste from end-of-life vehicles (the circular economy regulation for vehicles) entered into force on 13 August 2026. The project prepares a government proposal for its implementation.
fi-hanke-f3c1de1a.t: Implementation of the EU Vehicle Circular Economy Regulation

fi-hanke-f7a8b5a0.f: Government proposal to amend the Law on Military Intelligence (Home Peace Protection)
fi-hanke-f7a8b5a0.s: The proposal proposes that the Military Intelligence Act should include provisions on the use of certain methods of inquiry in the condition of permanent residence, with any other necessary changes to the tasks involved.
fi-hanke-f7a8b5a0.t: Act amending the Law on Military Intelligence (Home Peace Protection)

fi-hanke-f7cb4c79.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 10 of the Income Tax Act
fi-hanke-f7cb4c79.s: Paragraph 10 (10a) of the Income Tax Act is amended. This proposal would treat profits from indirect disposal of immovable property as income from Finland when transferring shares or other shares of a listed entity that are not subject to public trading.
fi-hanke-f7cb4c79.t: Act amending section 10 of the Income Tax Act

fi-hanke-f92114a3.f: Government proposal to amend the Act on the organisation of social and health care (unit costs of welfare areas)
fi-hanke-f92114a3.s: The project implements a government programme record for publishing unit costs in welfare areas.
fi-hanke-f92114a3.t: amending the Act on the organisation of social and health care (unit costs in welfare areas)

fi-hanke-f9b8b820.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Law on the Government
fi-hanke-f9b8b820.s: The proposal proposes a limited derogation from the general provisions on the date of public access to documents under the Government Act on the Government Council for certain documents held by ministries in connection with government negotiations.
fi-hanke-f9b8b820.t: Act amending the Law on the Government

fi-hanke-fbe1a393.s: Start work on the review of the Arbitration Act by drawing up an international comparison of legislation and arbitration activities in some other European countries (Sweden, Norway, Denmark, the Netherlands, Germany, Austria, France and England), drawn up by the Ministry of Justice as official work.

fi-hanke-fc20f54b.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for the approval and entry into force of the Agreement on Air Transport with the Republic of Colombia
fi-hanke-fc20f54b.s: The agreement is a bilateral air transport agreement which, inter alia, provides for the possibility and conditions under which the parties may designate airlines to exercise the traffic rights conferred by the agreement, which provides for the rights and obligations of airlines in the exercise of their traffic.
fi-hanke-fc20f54b.t: Agreement on air transport with the Republic of Colombia

fi-hanke-fefa73f6.f: Government proposal to amend the Law on precious metal products
fi-hanke-fefa73f6.s: National legislation (law and regulation on precious metal products) to meet the new levels of precious metal products authorised by the CCM (Convention on the Inspection and Staffing of precious metal products) and customs as a control body under the agreement.
fi-hanke-fefa73f6.t: Act amending the Act on precious metal products

fi-he-1-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation on the licensing of the export of projectiles components and amending Section 1 of Chapter 46 of the Firearms Act and the Criminal Code
fi-he-1-2025.s: The aim of the project is to help ensure the implementation of EU sanctions regulations, thereby preventing the export of ammunition and similar instruments to Russia in particular.
fi-he-1-2025.t: Act on the licensing of the export of projectiles components and amending Section 1 of Chapter 46 of the Code of Gunfire and Penal Code

fi-he-10-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Foreign Law
fi-he-10-2025.s: This is a legislative project to reform the regulation of the Foreign Code on the registration, submission and examination of an application for international protection, which is supported by, for example, a report on the examination of asylum applications and acceptance rates in different EU countries, as mentioned in the government programme.

fi-he-10-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Common Regional Law
fi-he-10-2026.s: The Joint Regional Law is amended in the context of the implementation of the objectives set out in the Government Programme. According to the Government Programme Record: "The Act is amended to promote the consolidation of shareholders, to enable meetings and to improve equal treatment of shareholders.
fi-he-10-2026.t: Act on the amendment of the Common Regional Law

fi-he-100-2023.f: Proposal of the Government to the Parliament of Finland amending section 11 of Chapter 40 of the Act on the Sami Courts and the Criminal Code
fi-he-100-2023.s: A revision of the Act on the Sami Courts is necessary. The provisions of the law are partly obsolete and problems with the functioning of the regulations have been identified. According to Prime Minister Petteri Orpo's government programme of 20 June 2023, the government's proposal for a Sami district court is to be submitted by the end of 2023 on the basis of the work of Chief of Staff of Timose Commission.
fi-he-100-2023.t: amending section 11 of Chapter 40 of the Act on the Sami Courts and the Criminal Code

fi-he-100-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law repealing section 5 of the Bakery Labour Act and amending the Law on the Posting of Workers
fi-he-100-2024.s: Working Group 1.2.-30.6.2024, completed on 8.5.2024, opinion of 20.5.- 26.7.2024, HE 100/2024 vp of 19.9.2024, laws (61 and 62/2025) of 28.2.2025, entry into force 1.3.2025.
fi-he-100-2024.t: Repeal of section 5 of the Bakery Labour Act and amendment of the Law on the posting of workers

fi-he-100-2025.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors for amendment and temporary amendment of the Act on the State Contribution to the Municipal Basic Services
fi-he-100-2025.s: The proposal proposes to amend the Act on the State participation in municipal basic services, which would increase the percentage of the State participation in municipal basic services by 0.71 percentage points, which would be 25.73 per cent from the beginning of 2026 and the municipalities' self-financing rate would be 74.27 per cent.
fi-he-100-2025.t: Amendment and temporary amendment of the Act on the State Contribution to the Municipal Basic Services

fi-he-100-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Passport and ID Card Act
fi-he-100-2026.s: The project is designed to prepare legislative proposals for a 10-year change in the maximum validity of the passport and, where possible, of the identity card, and to prepare any other necessary legislative amendments, with the aim of submitting the government's proposal to the Parliament of Finland during the autumn session of 2025.
fi-he-100-2026.t: Act amending the Passport and ID Card Act

fi-he-101-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to change the law on construction and to become separate related laws
fi-he-101-2024.s: The proposal proposes to amend the Construction Act, which will enter into force on 1 January 2025, in a number of respects, in accordance with the Government Programme of Petteri Orpo, which proposes to make some technical corrections to the Construction Act and the Lighthouse Act, which is intended to enter into force on 1 January 2025.
fi-he-101-2024.t: The law on the amendment of the law of construction and the related laws

fi-he-101-2025.f: Proposal of the Government to the Parliament of Finland as a law amending section 2 of the Act on State Financing of Evangelis-Lutheran Church for Certain Social Duties and section 119 of the Act on Orthodox Church
fi-he-101-2025.s: The proposal proposes to reduce the amount of State funding for social tasks performed by the Evangelis Lutheran Church and State aid to the Orthodox Church in 2026 and 2027.
fi-he-101-2025.t: Act amending section 2 of the Act on State Financing for Evangelis-Lutheran Church for Certain Societal Activities and section 119 of the Act on Orthodox Church

fi-he-101-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the Salmon Damage Fund in the pig sector
fi-he-101-2026.s: The project is designed to prepare the legislation needed to prepare, as a working group, for a risk management solution for salmonella damage in the pig sector, which would provide protection for salmonella in the pig sector through a fund outside the State budget.
fi-he-101-2026.t: Legal from the Salmon Damage Fund in the pig sector

fi-he-102-2020.s: The aim of the Regulation is to ensure that, in accordance with the principle of mutual recognition, Member States should recognise and implement decisions taken in other Member States in the context of criminal proceedings in the situations required by the Regulation, and in the field of judicial cooperation in criminal matters, framework decisions on the application of the principle of mutual recognition are in force (2003 / 577 / EC).
fi-he-102-2020.t: Mutual recognition of decisions on the freezing and revocation of a decision

fi-he-102-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Environmental Protection Act
fi-he-102-2024.s: The proposal implements the EU regulations on ozone depleting substances and fluorinated greenhouse gases, which have been in force since 11 March 2024.
fi-he-102-2024.t: Act amending the Environmental Protection Act

fi-he-102-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending legislation on language qualifications
fi-he-102-2025.s: The project will modernise general language qualifications and the language qualifications of the state administration. Digitisation of language qualifications will allow for smoother examination processes and respond to the growing number of graduates. The legislation on language qualifications will be amended as necessary.
fi-he-102-2025.t: amending the legislation on language qualifications

fi-he-103-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Waste Act
fi-he-103-2024.s: Amendment of the Waste Act, taking into account the Government Programme's inclusion of a limitation of the municipal responsibility for household waste and certain technical specifications, and the proposal also proposes a regulation supplementing the EU battery regulation on the market surveillance authority for which Tukes has been proposed.
fi-he-103-2024.t: Act on the amendment of the Waste Act

fi-he-103-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Basic Education Act and related laws
fi-he-103-2025.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending the Basic Education Act; Act amending the Law on the Financing of Education and Culture; Act amending the Act amending the Act on the Financing of Education and Culture; Amendment of section 24 of the Act on the State Contribution to Basic Services of the Municipality
fi-he-103-2025.t: Act amending the Basic Education Act and related laws

fi-he-103-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to reform legislation on the composition of administrative courts
fi-he-103-2026.s: The timeliness and effectiveness of the assembly provisions will be improved, inter alia, by increasing the range of assembly options, in order to provide a more flexible and appropriate response to the needs arising from different solutions.
fi-he-103-2026.t: Reform of legislation on the composition of administrative courts

fi-he-104-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending sections 3 and 4 of the Law on the Prevention and Compensation of Damage to Reconstituted Animals
fi-he-104-2024.s: The proposal proposes to introduce technical amendments to the Act on the Prevention and Compensation of Damage to Reconstituted Animals (15/2022), which would update the references to the new European Union State Aid Guidelines for Agriculture (2022 / C 485 / 01) and the new Nature Conservation Act (9/2023).
fi-he-104-2024.t: amending sections 3 and 4 of the Law on the prevention and compensation of damage caused by calmed animals

fi-he-104-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the Temporary Forest Incentive Scheme
fi-he-104-2025.s: The Forest Incentive Scheme Act (71/2023) would include an experiment with results-based subsidies and environmental tendering.
fi-he-104-2025.t: Act amending the Act on the Temporary Forest Incentive Scheme

fi-he-104-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Law on Military Intelligence and related laws
fi-he-104-2026.s: The project is designed to assess the need for changes to the provisions of the Military Intelligence Act and other accompanying acts in relation to existing legislation and the requirements of the current environment, and to prepare proposals for legislative changes on the basis of the assessment.
fi-he-104-2026.t: Act amending the Law on Military Intelligence and related laws

fi-he-105-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on digital information services in the transport system and related laws
fi-he-105-2025.s: The project will, inter alia, implement the necessary amendments to the Information Regulation of the Transport Services Act, based on the update of Directive 2010 / 40 / EU on the framework for the deployment of Intelligent Transport Systems in road transport and on interfaces between road transport and other modes of transport (ITS Directive).
fi-he-105-2025.t: The law on digital information services in the transport system and related laws

fi-he-105-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the prevention of money laundering and terrorist financing and related laws
fi-he-105-2026.s: The Ministry of Finance set up a working group on 10 May 2024 - 30 June 2025 to prepare a comprehensive reform of the regulation on the prevention of money laundering and terrorist financing. The draft draft of the Board of Directors was drawn up by a set working group. After a round of opinions, the further preparation of the Board's draft proposal was carried out as an official work.
fi-he-105-2026.t: Law on the Prevention of Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing and related Laws

fi-he-106-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending the Annex to the Act on the taxation of alcohol and alcoholic beverages
fi-he-106-2024.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending Annex to the Act on the taxation of alcohol and alcoholic beverages
fi-he-106-2024.t: amending the Annex to the Act on the taxation of alcohol and alcoholic beverages

fi-he-106-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on the scrapping premium for passenger cars in 2026 and 2027
fi-he-106-2025.s: The proposal provides for a temporary law on the scrapping premium for vehicles between 2026 and 2027, which would provide for a scrapping premium for the buyer of a new passenger car, subject to the condition that the buyer takes one old car for scrapping against one new passenger car.
fi-he-106-2025.t: Law on the scrapping premium for passenger cars in 2026 and 2027

fi-he-106-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the provision of digital services
fi-he-106-2026.s: The aim of the project is to prepare legislative proposals for legislative changes in line with the government programme, which would allow for increased automation in the provision of government advice in digital services, and to remove the barriers to the exploitation of autonomous technologies, in particular by section 6a of the Digital Services Act.
fi-he-106-2026.t: amending the Act on the provision of digital services

fi-he-107-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 11 of the Vehicle Tax Act and the Annex
fi-he-107-2024.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending section 11 of the Vehicle Tax Act and the Annex
fi-he-107-2024.t: Act amending section 11 of the Vehicle Tax Act and the Annex

fi-he-107-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 5 of the Act on electricity and natural gas network charges
fi-he-107-2025.s: The government's proposal increases electricity grid charges to cover the costs of the increasing electricity network control tasks of the Energy Agency.
fi-he-107-2025.t: Amendment of section 5 of the Act on electricity and natural gas network charges

fi-he-107-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation on e-business of the estate
fi-he-107-2026.s: The report of the working group and the legislative proposals contained in the report prepared by the legislative group on the 'Easy to manage' programme of the late family member were on the Opinion Service.fi's website at the turn of the year 2025-2026. The government's proposal was submitted to the Parliament of Finland on 4 June 2026. The legislation would enter into force on 1 February 2027.
fi-he-107-2026.t: Legal framework for e-business of the estate

fi-he-108-2024.f: The Board of Directors' proposal to the Parliament of Finland as a law on the income tax scale and on the amendment and temporary modification of the Income Tax Act of 2025 and as a number of other tax laws
fi-he-108-2024.s: The proposal also includes proposals for a child-specific increase of EUR 50 for income reduction and for a reform of the tax practices on financial bonuses.
fi-he-108-2024.t: on the income tax scale of 2025 and on the modification and temporary modification of the Income Tax Act and on certain other tax laws

fi-he-108-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation on the development of the job seeker's service process and employment services
fi-he-108-2025.s: The project will prepare the necessary legislative changes to implement government programme records on the labour service process and access to information for private employment services and will contribute to the dismantling of the municipal standards set out by the Government in Framework 2024.
fi-he-108-2025.t: Legislation on the development of the service process and employment services of the jobseeker

fi-he-108-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending section 4 of the Act on the Prevention and Compensation of Damage to Restoration Animals and the Act on the Law on the Law on the Prevention and Compensation of the Damage to Peaceful Animals
fi-he-108-2026.s: The solution includes both white-cheeky goose and seamezo in the game species mentioned in the hunting law, while at the same time calming down throughout the year. Protective hunting against both species allows for the protection of agriculture, fisheries or air transport from harm, while allowing for the exploitation of catches as food.
fi-he-108-2026.t: amending section 4 of the Act on the prevention and compensation of damage caused by restless animals

fi-he-109-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending the Act on Rehabilitation Work
fi-he-109-2025.s: In future, activation plans would only be drawn up on the basis of unemployment for persons receiving income support, while those entitled to unemployment benefit would in future be covered by a cross-sectoral employment plan in accordance with the Multinational Employment Promotion Act.
fi-he-109-2025.t: amending the Law on Rehabilitation Work

fi-he-109-2026.f: Draft legislation of the Board of Directors amending the General Aid Act, the Law on the organisation of employment services and the Law on General Language Qualifications
fi-he-109-2026.s: The task of the working group on integration support and language support for labour market support is to prepare legislative measures to implement government programme records on integration support and linguistic assistance for Prime Minister Petteri Orpo's government.
fi-he-109-2026.t: amending the General Aid Act, the Labour Services Act and the General Law on Language Qualifications

fi-he-11-2022.s: It is proposed to insert a new article in the Foreign Law providing for the security features of a visa, which would implement the Commission Implementing Decision on the uniform format of a visa adopted under the Council Regulation establishing a single format for visas.

fi-he-11-2023.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation amending the laws on unemployment protection, public employment services, business services and wage security
fi-he-11-2023.s: The Unemployment Protection Act, the Public Employment and Business Services Act, the Labour Services Organisation Act, the ELY Law, the Salary Security Act, the Seamen's Salary Guarantee Act and the Act on Municipal Experiment in Promoting Employment would be subject to minor changes.
fi-he-11-2023.t: Legislative changes to the laws on unemployment protection, public employment services, business services and wage security

fi-he-11-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on Competition and Consumer Protection
fi-he-11-2024.s: The project aims to prepare national regulation related to the Digital Market Act (Regulation (EU) 2022/1925 of the European Parliament and of the Council), although it is a directly applicable EU regulation, it is necessary to adopt complementary national regulation to ensure its effective and effective implementation.
fi-he-11-2024.t: Act amending the Competition and Consumer Protection Act

fi-he-11-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Foreign Law
fi-he-11-2025.s: Under point 10.3 (Immigration and Integration Policy) of the Government Programme, the conditions for family reunification are being changed. The Court of Justice of the European Union has adopted Decision C-279 / 20, which contradicts the Foreign Code. The European Commission has initiated infringement proceedings against Finland for a definition directive.

fi-he-11-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Driving Licence Act
fi-he-11-2026.s: The government programme has set the objective of improving road safety that there will be no road deaths in Finland in 2050, with the aim of promoting road safety, especially for young people, through changes in driving licence regulation.
fi-he-11-2026.t: Act amending the Driving Licence Act

fi-he-110-2024.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland as a law amending the Act on the State Contribution of the Municipal Basic Services and sections 56a and 59 of the Local Government Construction Act
fi-he-110-2024.s: The proposal provides for a percentage of State participation in basic municipal services and for temporary reductions and increases in the share of central government for 2025, as well as some technical needs to be clarified in the context of the implementation of the TER.
fi-he-110-2024.t: amending the Act on the State Contribution of the Local Government to Basic Services and sections 56a and 59 of the Local Government Construction Act

fi-he-110-2025.f: Proposal of the Government to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 5 of the Law on Family Care and section 12 of the Law on Family Care
fi-he-110-2025.s: - the proposal of the Board of Directors proposes to amend the Act on Family Care Support and the Act on Family Care.
fi-he-110-2025.t: Amendment of section 5 of the Law on Family Care and section 12 of the Family Care Act

fi-he-110-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on Medical Research, the Law on Clinical Research and the Biobank Act and to become certain other laws
fi-he-110-2026.s: The project will clarify the legislation on military research activities by identifying the needs for correction, change and coordination of existing regulation and by taking the necessary measures.
fi-he-110-2026.t: amending the Act on Medical Research, the Law on Clinical Research and the Law on Biobank and into certain other laws

fi-he-111-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on legislation on pharmaceutical reform and the implementation of pharmaceutical savings
fi-he-111-2025.s: Implement the government programme records of Prime Minister Petteri Orpo on the overall reform of the pharmacy economy, which aims at saving 30 million euros per year in public finances.
fi-he-111-2025.t: Legislation on pharmaceutical reform and the implementation of pharmaceutical savings

fi-he-111-2026.f: Presentation by the Government to the Parliament of Finland of the adoption and implementation of amendments to the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court in 2017 and 2019
fi-he-111-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court in 2017 and 2019; Amendment of Article 8 of the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court
fi-he-111-2026.t: With a view to adopting and implementing the amendments to the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court in 2017 and 2019

fi-he-112-2025.f: Draft legislation on general support to the Parliament of Finland by the Board of Directors
fi-he-112-2025.s: According to Prime Minister Petteri Orpo's government programme, the government is implementing a basic security reform that improves the profitability of work, facilitates social security and simplifies benefits, taking into account the recommendations and explanations made in the interim report of the Social Security Committee, with the aim of providing one general support.

fi-he-113-2024.f: Proposal of the Government to the Parliament of Finland as a law amending section 2 of the Act on State Financing of Evangelis-Lutheran Church for Certain Social Duties and section 119 of the Act on Orthodox Church
fi-he-113-2024.s: The proposal proposes to change the amount of state funding for social functions performed by the Evangelis Lutheran Church and State aid to the Orthodox Church.
fi-he-113-2024.t: Act amending section 2 of the Act on State Financing for Evangelis-Lutheran Church for Certain Societal Activities and section 119 of the Act on Orthodox Church

fi-he-113-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Social Welfare Act, the Act on Support for the Capacity of the Older Population and the Act on Social and Health Services for Older People and the Act on Social and Health Care Customer Fees
fi-he-113-2025.s: The aim of the presentation is to provide for the use of technology in social services and for the technology to be taken into account in calculating the 24-hour personnel dimensions of older people.
fi-he-113-2025.t: Act amending the Social Welfare Act, the Act on Support for the Capacity of the Older Population and the Act on Social and Health Services for Older People and the Act on Social and Health Care Customer Fees

fi-he-113-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to change the Income Tax Act and to change it temporarily
fi-he-113-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending and temporarily amending the Income Tax Act
fi-he-113-2026.t: Act amending and temporarily amending the Income Tax Act

fi-he-114-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Basic Education Act and related laws
fi-he-114-2024.s: The purpose of the performance is to clarify and clarify the forms of support received by the pupil and the regulation of their evaluation and plan; the student would always have the primary right to all support to help the student to complete the course of basic education.
fi-he-114-2024.t: Act amending the Basic Education Act and related laws

fi-he-114-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to change Chapter 4 of the Health Insurance Act
fi-he-114-2025.s: A study project has been launched at the Ministry of Social Affairs and Health to serve as a basis for the preparation of legislation to be launched in 2025, which will address the regulatory needs for the maximum price regulation of Kela taxis.
fi-he-114-2025.t: Act amending Chapter 4 of the Health Insurance Act

fi-he-114-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending section 4 of the Law on the refund of excise duty on certain energy products used in agriculture
fi-he-114-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending section 4 of the Act on the refund of excise duty on certain energy products used in agriculture
fi-he-114-2026.t: amending section 4 of the Law on the refund of excise duty on certain energy products used in agriculture

fi-he-115-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the Temporary Forest Incentive Scheme
fi-he-115-2024.s: The Forest Incentive Scheme Act (71/2023) would be amended, and there would be no further support for the creation of a new forest road, nor would there be any support for the creation of a new forest road in the context of a fundamental improvement, nor would it be possible to set up a search block for the funding of the nursery and young forest management.
fi-he-115-2024.t: Act amending the Act on the Temporary Forest Incentive Scheme

fi-he-115-2025.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland amending section 13 of the Law on Maintenance, Child Maintenance and Income Information System
fi-he-115-2025.s: According to Prime Minister Orpo's Board of Directors' Programme, the Government is exploring possibilities for improving the child's position in difficult divorce situations and in the judicial process. The government's budgetary plan states that maintenance support is to be reformed by regularly reviewing the level of maintenance support on the basis of older income data.
fi-he-115-2025.t: amending section 13 of the Law on Maintenance, Child Maintenance and Income Information System

fi-he-115-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on basic art education and related laws
fi-he-115-2026.s: Under the programme of Prime Minister Petteri Orpo's Government (2023), reform of the legislation on basic art education is proposed with the aim of improving the accessibility of teaching, taking into account the different fields of art.
fi-he-115-2026.t: Law on Basic Art Education and Related Laws

fi-he-116-2024.f: Draft laws of the Government to the Parliament of Finland amending sections 6 and 8 and repealing sections 6 and 8 of the Act on the amendment and provisional amendment of the Law on Charges
fi-he-116-2024.s: The project provides for full unit rates for the fairway charge and their entry into force from 1 January 2025.
fi-he-116-2024.t: As a law, sections 6 and 8 of the Rail Charges Act and sections 6 and 8 of the Law amending and temporarily amending the Rail Charges Act are repealed.

fi-he-116-2025.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland amending section 64 of the Act on Social Assistance, the Law on the Processing of Customer Data in Social and Health Care and section 10 of the Act on Rehabilitation Activities
fi-he-116-2025.s: The Board of Directors of the Government of Prime Minister Orpo implements a comprehensive reform of income support, which reduces long-term dependency on income support and clarifies the role of income support as a last-resort basic security benefit.
fi-he-116-2025.t: amending section 64 of the Act on Social Assistance, the Law on the Processing of Customer Data in Social and Health Care and section 10 of the Act on Rehabilitation Work

fi-he-116-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for adoption and implementation of the Second Additional Protocol to the World Postal Union Convention and for the Law amending section 77 of the Postal Act
fi-he-116-2026.s: The aim of the project is to bring into force the Second Additional Protocol to the World Postal Union Convention and its provisions under its legislation at legal level and to take other measures necessary for national transposition.
fi-he-116-2026.t: With a view to adopting and implementing the Second Additional Protocol to the World Postal Union Convention and amending section 77 of the Postal Act

fi-he-117-2024.f: Draft Act of the Government to the Parliament of Finland amending the Act of the Government of Patents and Registration
fi-he-117-2024.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending the Act on the Government of Patents and Registers
fi-he-117-2024.t: Act amending the Act on the Government of Patents and Registration

fi-he-117-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 3 of the Act on social and health care charges
fi-he-117-2025.s: A proposal for a amendment to section 3 of the Act on social and health care customer charges, which would mean an increase in the ceiling for the levy on social and health services not used and cancelled.
fi-he-117-2025.t: Amendment of section 3 of the Act on social and health care charges

fi-he-117-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 50 of the Civil Service Act and the Security Clearance Act
fi-he-117-2026.s: The project is preparing amendments to the State Civil Service Act (750/1994).
fi-he-117-2026.t: Act amending section 50 of the Civil Service Act and the Security Clearing Act

fi-he-118-2024.f: Presentation by the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland for the repeal of the legislation on the limited liability company Work Channel Oy
fi-he-118-2024.s: The company's employment activity has not started according to the objectives set for the company. The Board of Directors has decided that the funding allocated to the company will be abolished and the company will be discontinued.
fi-he-118-2024.t: To repeal the legislation on a limited liability company called Working Channel Oy

fi-he-118-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the amendment of the Health Care Act and related laws
fi-he-118-2025.s: The prior health check on student health care and the defence forces would be combined and a separate call check would be abolished. The full-age students' health check would be converted into a needs-based one. Updating the regulation of health checks on the health care of Neuvola, school health care and preventive mouth.
fi-he-118-2025.t: Law on the amendment of the Health Care Act and related laws

fi-he-118-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to change the annual leave law and become other laws
fi-he-118-2026.s: The working group will prepare the legislative changes required by the government's mid-term review to regulate savings free, which may invite experts, draw up its report in the form of a government proposal and submit its report to the Ministry for further preparation.
fi-he-118-2026.t: The law of changing the annual leave law and making certain other laws

fi-he-119-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on emissions trading for fossil fuel distribution
fi-he-119-2024.s: The update of the Emissions Trading Directive will set up a new emissions trading scheme for fuel distribution, which would largely cover the distribution of fuel outside the current emissions trading framework, and will have to be implemented by the end of June 2024.
fi-he-119-2024.t: Act on emissions trading for fossil fuel distribution

fi-he-119-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the Financing of Unemployment Benefits
fi-he-119-2025.s: The proposal would set unemployment insurance contributions for 2026.
fi-he-119-2025.t: Act amending the Act on the financing of unemployment benefits

fi-he-119-2026.f: Draft arbitration and related laws of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland
fi-he-119-2026.s: Under the government programme, the needs for the reform of the Arbitration Act are clarified and the necessary legislative changes are prepared to promote the competitiveness of Finnish arbitration activities. The Arbitration Act is technically modernised to reflect best international practices.

fi-he-12-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on legislation on micro-mobility
fi-he-12-2025.s: The purpose of the project is to draw up a government proposal for legislative amendments to the regulations on micro-mobility (including electric scooters), in accordance with government programme records.

fi-he-12-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on Electronic Communications Services
fi-he-12-2026.s: On 15 January 2025 the Ministry of Transport and Communications has set up a legislative project to amend the Act on Electronic Communications Services (917/2014) to criminalise the unauthorised possession of radio equipment.
fi-he-12-2026.t: Act amending the Act on Electronic Communications Services

fi-he-120-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Act on the organisation of employment services and the Act on preparedness
fi-he-120-2024.s: As a rule, wage subsidies could not be granted to municipalities or joint municipal boards. However, wage subsidies could be granted to the municipality or joint municipal boards for the recruitment of disabled persons or long-term unemployed persons aged 60 or over. The Act of Preparedness would be amended as a result of the transfer of responsibility for organising employment services.
fi-he-120-2024.t: Act amending the Act on the organisation of employment services and the Act on the Recruitment of the State Employment Services

fi-he-120-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Consumer Protection Act and for intermediaries of certain consumer credit and related laws
fi-he-120-2025.s: The laws implementing the Consumer Credit Directive and the Consumer Rights Directive amending the Directive were adopted on 16 January 2026.
fi-he-120-2025.t: Act amending the Consumer Protection Act and regarding intermediaries of certain consumer credit and related laws

fi-he-120-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to change the law of imprisonment and related laws
fi-he-120-2026.s: The project will continue to develop the Penitentiary Act and the Penitentiary Act (first project OM039: 00/2021), which will further examine the needs for the amendment of that legislation, assessing the need for the amendment of the Penitentiary Act and the Penitentiary Act, and preparing the necessary amendments to the provisions.
fi-he-120-2026.t: Act amending the Act of imprisonment and related laws

fi-he-121-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for laws amending and temporarily amending the Act on the Promotion of the Use of Renewable Fuels in Transport and related laws
fi-he-121-2024.s: It proposes to amend the Dissemination Obligations and Sustainability Act and repeal the so-called KHK Act, which is based on the entries made by Prime Minister Petteri Orpo's Government's government programme on the obligation to distribute and the national implementation of the updated Renewable Energy Directive.
fi-he-121-2024.t: amending and temporarily amending the Act on the Promotion of the Use of Renewable Fuels in Transport and related laws

fi-he-121-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending the Act on the processing of personal data by police, the Act on the processing of personal data by immigration authorities, section 131 of the Foreign Code and section 1 of Chapter 2 of the Police Act
fi-he-121-2025.s: The project is designed to assess the need for legislative change concerning the processing of biometric data stored in the passport register and the identity card register and stored in the police register pursuant to section 131 of the Foreign Code for purposes other than their original processing.
fi-he-121-2025.t: amending the Act on the processing of personal data by police, the Act on the processing of personal data in the administration of immigration, section 131 of the Foreign Code and section 1 of Chapter 2 of the Police Act

fi-he-121-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on criminal intelligence legislation
fi-he-121-2026.s: The project is designed to prepare the main provisions on police criminal investigations and thus to improve police access to information on internal security threats related to police tasks.

fi-he-122-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation amending section 4 of the Disability Services Act and the Social Welfare Act
fi-he-122-2024.s: According to Prime Minister Petteri Orpo's government programme, the government is urgently launching a legislative process aimed at safeguarding the rights of people with disabilities and access to services.
fi-he-122-2024.t: As laws amending section 4 of the Disability Services Act and the Social Welfare Act

fi-he-122-2025.f: Draft law of the Government amending the Act on the grounds for access to and the location of public services and repealing section 10a (3) of the Law on Public Service Joint Service
fi-he-122-2025.s: The proposed regulation would ensure, in an economically effective way, a minimum level of business activity in the State authorities and promote equality between people in the public administration, and would propose a common regulation of the State's customer service activities, which would be mainly enshrined in the Act on State Services.
fi-he-122-2025.t: Act amending the Act on the criteria for access to and the location of public services and repealing section 10a (3) of the Law on Public Service Joint Service

fi-he-122-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to change the gun law
fi-he-122-2026.s: The legislative project assesses and prepares the necessary amendments to the Firearms Act (1/1998) and the Firearms Regulation (145/1998).
fi-he-122-2026.t: Law on the modification of the firearm

fi-he-123-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on legislation on the strengthening of the state and local government finances and on changes in sickness benefit
fi-he-123-2024.s: The adjustment of Prime Minister Orpo's government programme will have a significant impact on expenditure on social security funds. On 25 April 2024 the Government has decided on a budgetary plan for the period 2025-2028, and has aligned the adjustment measures to channel the social security funds' impact and to change the formula for calculating sickness benefit.
fi-he-123-2024.t: Legislation on the direction of savings by social security funds to strengthen the state and municipalities' finances and on changes in sickness benefit

fi-he-123-2025.f: Proposal of the Government to the Parliament of Finland repealing the Act amending the Act on the Tax on soft drinks and the Annex to the Act on the Tax on Alcohol and Drink and the Act on the Tax on soft drinks
fi-he-123-2025.s: Legislative proposals: Act repealing the Act amending the Law on the Tax on soft drinks; Act amending the Act on the Tax on soft drinks; Act amending the Annex to the Act on the Tax on Alcohol and Drinks
fi-he-123-2025.t: repealing the Act amending the Act on the Tax on soft drinks and the Annex to the Act on the Tax on Alcohol and Drink and the Act on the Tax on soft drinks

fi-he-123-2026.f: The Board of Directors' draft law to the Parliament of Finland repealing certain provisions of the Enterprise and Community Information Act, section 3 (3) (11) and section 5 (26) of the Financial Supervisory Act and section 1 (7) (f) and section 10 (11) of the Financial Supervisory Supervisory Authority Charges Act
fi-he-123-2026.s: The project is preparing a law to repeal the provisions on the LEI on the Business and Community Information Act.
fi-he-123-2026.t: By repealing certain provisions of the Enterprise and Community Information Act, section 3 (3) (11) and section 5 (26) of the Financial Supervisory Act and section 1 (7) (f) and section 10 (11) of the Financial Supervisory Authority Charges Act

fi-he-124-2024.f: The Board's proposal to the Parliament of Finland to change the Act on Rehabilitation Benefits and Rehabilitation Benefits and the Act on Rehabilitation Benefits of the Social Insurance Institution and the related laws
fi-he-124-2024.s: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending the Act on Rehabilitation Benefits and Rehabilitation Benefits of the Social Insurance Institution
fi-he-124-2024.t: Act amending the Act on Rehabilitation Benefits and Rehabilitation Benefits of the Social Insurance Institution and related laws

fi-he-124-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on legislation on the priority of electronic service in public administration
fi-he-124-2025.s: The Ministry of Finance set up a legislative working group on 13 May 2024 as a primary component of the programme for the promotion of digital public communications (VN / 36598/2023) to prepare legislative amendments to the objectives of the programme for the promotion of digital public authorities, the mandate of which was from 13.05.2024 to 31.03.2025.
fi-he-124-2025.t: Legislation on the primacy of e-service in public administration

fi-he-124-2026.f: Draft law of the Board of Directors amending the entry into force of the General Aid Act
fi-he-124-2026.s: The proposal proposes an amendment to the general allowance for a partial early retirement pension, which would be applicable to the entry into force of the General Aid Act (48/2026), which would not take into account the partial early retirement pension as the income of the general allowance if the decision to grant the pension had been taken before 16 January 2026.
fi-he-124-2026.t: Act amending the entry into force provisions of the General Aid Act

fi-he-125-2024.f: Draft laws of the Board of Directors amending the Act on Rehabilitation Benefits and Rehabilitation Benefits and the Act on Rehabilitation Benefits of the Social Insurance Institution and amending the Act on Rehabilitation Benefits of the Social Insurance Institution and on certain other laws
fi-he-125-2024.s: The minimum age for national pension, guaranteed pension, sickness benefit and Rehabilitation benefits for Kela would be increased from 16 to 18 years (in 2009 and thereafter). The age limit of the Disability Benefits Act is proposed to be amended in the same way, and the exceptional situations for paying unemployment benefits to a minor would be limited.
fi-he-125-2024.t: amending the Act on Rehabilitation Benefits and Rehabilitation Benefits of the Social Insurance Institution and the Act on Rehabilitation Benefits and on certain other laws

fi-he-125-2025.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland as a law amending sections 52 and 52 f of the Act on the taxation of business income and the Act on the valuation of assets in taxation and amending section 33b of the Income Tax Act on a provisional basis
fi-he-125-2025.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending sections 52 and 52 (f) of the Act on the taxation of business income; Act amending the Law on the Valuation of Assets in Taxation; Act amending section 33b of the Income Tax Act
fi-he-125-2025.t: As a law amending sections 52 and 52 f of the Act on the taxation of business income and the Act on the valuation of assets in taxation and amending section 33b of the Income Tax Act on a provisional basis

fi-he-125-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Private Road Act
fi-he-125-2026.s: The project will prepare the necessary amendments to the Private Road Act (560/2018) to clarify the law and to clarify some of its provisions on the basis of feedback from stakeholders and, for example, to clarify the legal status of the payment of private road charges.
fi-he-125-2026.t: Act on the amendment of the Private Road Act

fi-he-126-2024.f: Draft laws of the Board of Directors amending the laws on general housing support and on housing aid for pensioners
fi-he-126-2024.s: The proposal proposes to amend the laws on general housing support and on housing aid for pensioners, based on the government programme of Prime Minister Petteri Orpo and the public finance plan for the period from 2025 to 2028.
fi-he-126-2024.t: Act amending the laws on general housing aid and on housing aid for pensioners

fi-he-126-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 6 of the State Pension Fund Act
fi-he-126-2025.s: The Government's proposal proposes to amend the State Pension Fund Act to increase the amount transferred from the Fund to the State budget by 1.2 percentage points per year, with a permanent amount of 46.2% from 2028 onwards, and a one-off transfer of 18.7% to 2027.
fi-he-126-2025.t: Amendment of section 6 of the State Pension Fund Act

fi-he-126-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland for laws amending the Companies Act and the Cooperative Act as well as related laws
fi-he-126-2026.s: Updating the Companies Act, starting with previous studies, to reduce the administrative burden on companies and the general conditions for business by reforming the regulation on public limited liability companies, to improve the winding-up process and the regulation on the loss of equity.
fi-he-126-2026.t: Act amending the Companies Act and the Cooperative Act and related laws

fi-he-127-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on Social and Health Services for Older People
fi-he-127-2024.s: In order to ensure financial sustainability and the availability of staff in the preparation of the budgetary plan, a solution was reached in spring, whereby, from the beginning of 2025 onwards, the personnel dimensions in the 24-hour care units of the elderly will be 0.6 employees per customer on a permanent basis.
fi-he-127-2024.t: Amendment of the Act on Support for the Capacity of the Older Population and on Social and Health Services for Older People

fi-he-127-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Mining Mineral Tax Act
fi-he-127-2025.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending the Mining Mineral Tax Act
fi-he-127-2025.t: Act amending the Mining Mineral Tax Act

fi-he-127-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending Chapter 25 of the Penal Code and for a number of other laws
fi-he-127-2026.s: Assess the legislative changes required and prepare for the national implementation of the amending Directive amending the Directive on trafficking in human beings (Directive (EU) 2024/1712 amending Directive 2011 / 36 / EU on the prevention and fight against trafficking in human beings and the protection of victims of trafficking).
fi-he-127-2026.t: Law on the amendment of Chapter 25 of the Criminal Code and other laws

fi-he-128-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to change the National Pensions Act
fi-he-128-2024.s: As part of the budgetary plan for the period from 2025 to 2028, the government has aligned that the payment of benefits under the National Pensions Act to non-residents is discontinued in accordance with EU practices.
fi-he-128-2024.t: Act amending the National Pensions Act

fi-he-128-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation supplementing the EU Data Regulation
fi-he-128-2025.s: The EU Data Act aims to promote a fair distribution of data between data economy operators and the development and innovation of new innovative products or related services in secondary markets.
fi-he-128-2025.t: Complementary legislation to the EU Data Regulation

fi-he-128-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on utility model law
fi-he-128-2026.s: In May 2022, the Ministry of Employment and the Economy set up a working group to prepare a comprehensive reform of patent law, as part of the reform, which has also assessed the utility model system and its need for the future.
fi-he-128-2026.t: Act amending the law on utility model law

fi-he-129-2024.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland for a Act amending the Health Insurance Act and the Medical Act and repealing Article 2 of the Act amending and temporarily amending the Health Insurance Act
fi-he-129-2024.s: On 25 April 2024, the Government adopted a decision on a budgetary plan for the period from 2025 to 2028 and aligned the sustainability of public finances with the need to improve with savings in pharmaceuticals.
fi-he-129-2024.t: repealing Article 2 of the Act amending the Health Insurance Act and the Medical Act and amending and temporarily amending the Health Insurance Act

fi-he-129-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the organisation of social and health care services and the Act on the organisation of rescue services
fi-he-129-2025.s: The project implements multi-production government programme entries in two phases, the first phase of which is covered by this project plan, and other regulatory changes linked to the organisation of social and health care as part of the first phase.
fi-he-129-2025.t: Act amending the Act on the organisation of social and health care services and the Act on the organisation of rescue services

fi-he-129-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the law on equality between men and women and to make related laws
fi-he-129-2026.s: The national implementation of the EU Wage and Transparency Directive (EU) 2023 / 970 proposes amendments to the Equal Opportunities Act and related laws.
fi-he-129-2026.t: Act amending the Law on equality between men and women and related laws

fi-he-13-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for laws amending the Unemployment Security Act and certain other laws
fi-he-13-2024.s: According to section 4.3 of the Government Programme of Prime Minister Orpo, Social Security for Employment, the following changes are being prepared to the Unemployment Security Act: the amount of earnings day allowance is staggered and waived both age-related derogations and the accumulation of the employment condition from paid work. The changes would apply from 1.9.2024.
fi-he-13-2024.t: Act amending the Unemployment Security Act and certain other laws

fi-he-13-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation on regional government reform
fi-he-13-2025.s: The project is designed to prepare the legislative amendments to the Government's proposal, including impact assessments, concerning the organisation of the functions and administration of Valvira, Regional Administrative Agencies, ELY and the Åland State Agency in the new National Agency, the Lifecycle Centres and the Åland State Agency.
fi-he-13-2025.t: Legislative framework for regional government reform

fi-he-13-2026.f: Draft laws of the Government amending sections 13 and 19 of the General Aid Act and Section 4 of Chapter 10 of the Unemployment Security Act
fi-he-13-2026.s: The General Law would be amended so that the provision on waiting time would not apply during the course of self-study of employment training and of self-training for jobseekers supported by unemployment benefit and of the self-learning of literacy of the Act on the promotion of full-time integration.
fi-he-13-2026.t: amending sections 13 and 19 of the General Aid Act and Section 4 of Chapter 10 of the Unemployment Security Act

fi-he-130-2022.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to ensure the protection of essential health care and home care during the labour battle
fi-he-130-2022.t: Securing essential health care and home care during a labour struggle

fi-he-130-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on mediation in criminal matters and certain disputes
fi-he-130-2024.s: Proposed amendment of the law on mediation in criminal matters and in certain disputes; implementation of the government programme's record of the abolition of family and close relationship violence as a rule.
fi-he-130-2024.t: Act amending the Act on the Conciliation of Criminal Cases and Certain Disputes

fi-he-130-2025.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland as a law amending the Act on the amendment of the self-employed pension law and amending section 11 of the Act on the replacement of accident and service illness in a crisis management function
fi-he-130-2025.s: Change the upper limit for the upward revision of the entrepreneur's YEL income to cover all YEL earnings for regular review, which is valid until 31.12.2028. In addition, the "Crisis Management Accident Act 'provides for a change in the provision for reimbursement of psychological support or treatment, extending the period from one year to two.
fi-he-130-2025.t: Amendment of the Act amending the Act on the amendment of the self-employed pension law and of section 11 of the Act on the replacement of accident and service illness in a crisis management function

fi-he-130-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the legislation on the ban on the keeping of animals
fi-he-130-2026.s: The project will examine the penalties for animal protection offences and assess the possibilities for extending the ban on animal husbandry and improving controls and preparing legislative proposals in this regard.
fi-he-130-2026.t: amending the legislation on the prohibition of animal husbandry

fi-he-131-2024.f: Draft legislation of the Government to the Parliament of Finland on children and young people on the therapy moon
fi-he-131-2024.s: The proposal would strengthen the prevention and treatment of mental health problems of children and young people, which are the responsibility of basic services, and would complement the legislation on access to health care for children and young people in the care and social care of mental health care services.
fi-he-131-2024.t: Legislation on children and young people in therapy

fi-he-131-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the amendment of the Alcohol Act
fi-he-131-2025.s: The draft is part of the implementation of the government programme of the Government of Prime Minister Petteri Orpo, which provides for the government's responsible reform of alcohol policy in the European direction and the continuation of the 2018 overall reform of the alcohol law, with the aim of promoting fair and open competition, and the government has agreed to a number of measures in the field of alcohol trade.
fi-he-131-2025.t: Law on the amendment of the Alcohol Act

fi-he-131-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the enforcement of the legislation on the apartment information system
fi-he-131-2026.s: The proposed legislative amendment would allow for the conversion of the bonds held by creditors into electronic owner entries in the property register without the issue of the share certificate to the Land Survey, thus speeding up the transition to the electronic system and bringing cost savings.
fi-he-131-2026.t: Act amending the Act on the enforcement of the legislation on the apartment information system

fi-he-132-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending the Annex to the Act on Excise Tax on Liquid Fuels
fi-he-132-2025.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending the Annex to the Act on Excise Tax on Liquid Fuels
fi-he-132-2025.t: amending the Annex to the Act on Excise Tax on Liquid Fuels

fi-he-132-2026.f: Draft legislation on the winding-up and delegation of duties of the Labour Council and the Cooperation Ombudsman to the Parliament of Finland
fi-he-132-2026.s: Report by the Working Party on the Dissolution of the Working Council on savings and needs to improve the functioning of the labour market.
fi-he-132-2026.t: Legislative framework for the closure and delegation of tasks of the Labour Council and the Office of the Cooperation Ombudsman

fi-he-133-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on Income Support
fi-he-133-2024.s: taking into account additional food expenditure due to celiac disease in basic income support, and correcting, as a technical amendment, the legal references to the Act on income support to reflect the legal situation which will come into force on 1 January 2025;
fi-he-133-2024.t: Amendment of the Act on Social Assistance

fi-he-133-2025.f: Presentation of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland of the Law on the National Skills Information Reserve and related laws
fi-he-133-2025.s: The proposal provides for legislation on a new digital service to support training and career choices, skills development and matching of labour and training demand and supply.
fi-he-133-2025.t: Law on the National Skills Information Reserve and related laws

fi-he-133-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on the implementation and control of certain obligations under the Regulation of the Parliament of Finland and of the Council on critical raw materials and related laws
fi-he-133-2026.s: The project will prepare the main national provisions required by Regulation (EU) 1252/2024 on critical raw materials in the EU, which will prepare a new law on the implementation, control and sanctions of certain obligations of the Regulation on critical raw materials in the EU, as well as amendments to certain other laws.
fi-he-133-2026.t: on the implementation and control of certain obligations under the Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on critical raw materials and on related laws

fi-he-134-2024.f: Draft legislation of the Government to the Parliament of Finland amending sections 51a and 51b of the Health Act and sections 10a and 10b of the Law on Higher Education.
fi-he-134-2024.s: The proposal proposes that the maximum duration of access to emergency care be restored to 23 years of age in outpatient primary and to 6 months in oral care, not for children and young people under 23 years of age, but to maintain the current regulation of the care guarantee.
fi-he-134-2024.t: Act amending sections 51a and 51b of the Health Act and sections 10a and 10b of the Law on the Education of Higher Education Students

fi-he-134-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for approval and enforcement of the agreement with Norway on international taxi traffic and for a number of other laws
fi-he-134-2025.s: Lulu Ranne, Minister for Transport and Communications, and Jon- Ivar Nygård, Minister for Transport of Norway, signed an agreement between the Government of the Republic of Finland and the Government of the Kingdom of Norway on international taxi traffic on the road 13 March 2025 in Oslo. The agreement will be implemented in both countries in accordance with national procedures.
fi-he-134-2025.t: Adoption and entry into force of the Agreement with Norway on international carriage by taxi and into several other laws

fi-he-134-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 46a of the Law on the Supervision of Labour Protection and the Cooperation on Health Protection at Work, section 76 of the Act on the Activities and Financing of the Institute of Occupational Health and on the Processing of Personal Data in Social and Health Care
fi-he-134-2026.s: The proposal amends the regulation on the obligation for doctors to report occupational diseases and other work-related diseases.
fi-he-134-2026.t: Amendment of section 46a of the Law on the Supervision of Labour Protection and the Cooperation on Health Protection at Work, section 76 of the Act on the Activities and Financing of the Institute of Occupational Health and on the Processing of Customer Data in Social and Health Care

fi-he-135-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend sections 4 and 8 of the Unemployment Security Act and the Act on the Financing of Unemployment Benefits
fi-he-135-2024.s: In line with the Government Framework Decision, the active-time increments paid for employment-friendly services will be abandoned and the needs for labour market support will be strengthened.
fi-he-135-2024.t: Act amending sections 4 and 8 of the Unemployment Security Act and the Act on the financing of unemployment benefits

fi-he-135-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to repeal the Act on the State Housing Fund and to legislate on guarantee fees for state-subsidised housing
fi-he-135-2025.s: The State Housing Fund is wound up as a non-state-funded fund and consolidated into the State budget on 1 January 2026. The government programme provides for the introduction of guarantee payments (0.5%) in new government-subsidised loans for interest subsidies on government-subsidised dwellings.
fi-he-135-2025.t: Act repealing the Act on the State Housing Fund and the Act on the Guarantee Fees for Government Supported Housing

fi-he-135-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending sections 3 and 283 of the Real Estate Act and section 76 of the Private Road Act
fi-he-135-2026.s: Support for the basic improvement of the land register of the Land Surveying Institute as the administrator of the Real Estate Register by reviewing the legislation on the procedure for the provision of the Real Estate Act and the Private Road Act.
fi-he-135-2026.t: Act amending sections 3 and 283 of the Real Estate Act and section 76 of the Private Road Act

fi-he-136-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to repeal the Act on the Financial and Development Centre for Housing
fi-he-136-2024.s: The Aara Centre for Housing Financing and Development as an independent agency will be dissolved and its existing tasks and staff will be transferred to the Ministry of the Environment as from 1.3.2025, when, in connection with the Ministry of the Environment, the Centre for the Construction of Housing, supported by the State, will start.
fi-he-136-2024.t: Repeal of the Act on the Financial and Development Centre for Housing

fi-he-136-2025.f: Proposal of the Government to the Parliament of Finland amending section 2 of the Act on the Tax on Values
fi-he-136-2025.s: The tax scale of Section 2 of the Tax Code would be increased by 35% to take account of cost developments in the years 2002-2025. In the lower group of values on the tax scale, the increase would be higher to cover the cost of processing of the claims for value added tax in those groups, as well as the list of public entities (e.g. welfare areas).
fi-he-136-2025.t: amending section 2 of the Law on the Value Added Tax

fi-he-136-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland as a law amending section 1 of the Law on the supervision of ship safety and the execution of the fine
fi-he-136-2026.s: The aim of the project is to adopt a new law on ship safety control and to implement the ship safety regulation of the maritime transport package, the so-called Flag State Directive and the Port State Inspection Directive.
fi-he-136-2026.t: Amendment of section 1 of the Law on the Control of Ship Safety and the Enforcement of the fine

fi-he-137-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Law on the Government
fi-he-137-2025.s: The Law on the Government Council is amended to include regulation on the Legislative Review Board, documents in government archives and the procedure for the appointment of the function in the Government Council and its Ministries.
fi-he-137-2025.t: Act amending the Law on the Government

fi-he-137-2026.f: Government proposal to amend the legislation on penalties for loss to the Parliament of Finland
fi-he-137-2026.s: The project implements the decriminalisation record of the government programme and implements the so-called EU Condition Directive (2024/1260) at national level.
fi-he-137-2026.t: Amendment of the legislation on penalties for loss

fi-he-138-2022.f: Government proposal to amend the Cross-Border Health Care Act
fi-he-138-2022.s: In addition, taking into account the obligations of the patient directive (2011 / 24 / EU), the impact of the amendments to the Health Insurance Act on the reimbursement process for medical expenses incurred abroad and the need for change in implementation, will be assessed.
fi-he-138-2022.t: amending the Law on Cross-Border Health Care

fi-he-138-2024.f: Proposal of the Government to the Parliament of Finland for the approval and entry into force of an agreement with Ukraine on the gainful employment of members of the family of staff of diplomatic or consular missions or of representatives of international intergovernmental organisations
fi-he-138-2024.s: The Government's proposal concerns the acceptance and entry into force of an agreement between the Government of the Republic of Finland and the Government of Ukraine on the employment of members of the family of staff of diplomatic, consular or international representation in intergovernmental organisations.
fi-he-138-2024.t: on the approval and entry into force of an agreement with Ukraine on the gainful employment of family members of diplomatic or consular missions or of members of the staff of delegations in international intergovernmental organisations

fi-he-138-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 2 of the Act on the financing of state research and development activities 2024-2030
fi-he-138-2025.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending section 2 of the Law on the financing of state research and development activities from 2024 to 2030
fi-he-138-2025.t: Act amending section 2 of the Law on State funding for R & D in the period 2024-2030
