fi-he-138-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on Pre-litigation, the Law on Criminal Matters and certain other laws
fi-he-138-2026.s: The project would cover measures other than the negotiation of charges and the reform of the leniency procedure. The preparation of the extension of the scope of the proceedings will be carried out by the Working Party set up in autumn 2023 and the preparation of the overall assessment of the fine procedure by the Working Group set up in autumn 2024.
fi-he-138-2026.t: Act amending the Act on Pre-litigation, the Law on Criminal Matters and certain other laws

fi-he-139-2024.f: Draft law of the Government to the Parliament of Finland on the exchange of information between law enforcement authorities of the Member States of the European Union and on certain related laws
fi-he-139-2024.s: The project aims at the national implementation of Directive (EU) 2023 / 977 on the exchange of information between law enforcement authorities of the Member States of the European Parliament and of the Council and repealing Council Framework Decision 2006 / 960 / JHA "Information Exchange Directive" within the set deadline.
fi-he-139-2024.t: Law on the exchange of information between law enforcement authorities of the Member States of the European Union and as specific related laws

fi-he-139-2025.f: Draft laws of the Board of Directors amending the Act on Alternative Fund Managers and the Act on Investment Funds and related laws
fi-he-139-2025.s: The project aims to make the necessary changes to national legislation following the amendments to the Alternative Fund Managers Directive and the Investment Funds Directive, which is prepared by the Board of Directors for the amendment of the Alternative Fund Managers Act and the Investment Fund Act and of certain other laws.
fi-he-139-2025.t: Act amending the Act on Alternative Fund Managers and the Act on Investment Funds and related laws

fi-he-139-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend sections 5 and 7 of the Act on the Safety Information Report
fi-he-139-2026.s: The legislative project prepares the necessary amendments to the Act on Safety Information (466/2012), which is the basis for the introduction of the Cell Broadcast Warning System, and other necessary amendments to the Act on the Safety Notice. The Board of Directors' proposal is to be submitted to the Parliament of Finland during the spring session of 2026.
fi-he-139-2026.t: Act amending sections 5 and 7 of the Dangerous Information Act

fi-he-14-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend sections 2 and 19 of the Act on labour dispute settlement and the Conditions for certain industrial action
fi-he-14-2025.s: The Board of Directors implements the Parliamentary Statement (EV 105/2022) and prepares legislation to ensure the organisation of protective work in conflict situations.
fi-he-14-2025.t: Act amending sections 2 and 19 of the Act on labour dispute settlement and the Conditions for certain industrial action

fi-he-14-2026.f: Government proposal for legislation on emergency detention and on changing the procedure for the release of prisoners in prison
fi-he-14-2026.s: In February 2026, the Government has submitted a proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation on emergency detention and the modification of the procedure for the release of life prisoners, in order to ensure that the most dangerous prisoners are not released, in accordance with the government programme.
fi-he-14-2026.t: Legislative changes to the security and release procedure for life prisoners

fi-he-140-2025.f: Draft law of the Government to the Parliament of Finland amending the Act on the disclosure of information by digital undertakers in the field of taxation and repealing section 17f (2) to (4) of the Tax Procedure Act
fi-he-140-2025.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending the Act on the obligation to provide information to digital platform economic operators in the field of taxation; Act repealing section 17f (2) to (4) of the Tax Procedure Act
fi-he-140-2025.t: Act amending the Act on the disclosure of information by digital platform economic operators in the field of taxation and repealing section 17f (2) to (4) of the Tax Procedure Act

fi-he-140-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation on criminal intelligence of the Border Guard
fi-he-140-2026.s: The project is designed to prepare the main provisions on criminal intelligence of the Border Guard, thereby improving the ability of the Border Guard to better inform the Border Guard about internal security threats associated with the tasks of the Border Guard.
fi-he-140-2026.t: Legal framework for border guard criminal intelligence

fi-he-141-2024.f: Draft laws of the Government amending sections 18b and 22a of the VAT and Åland Provinces Act on derogations from VAT and excise legislation
fi-he-141-2024.s: Changes to the VAT Code on VAT rates: transfer of goods falling under the current 10% reduced VAT rate to the 14% rate, excluding newspapers and magazines; transfer of incontinence protection, menstrual protection and child diapers from the general rate to the reduced 14% tax rate.
fi-he-141-2024.t: amending sections 18b and 22a of the Law on the Derogations from the VAT Act and the Åland Province

fi-he-141-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 21 of the Tax Procedure Act
fi-he-141-2025.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending section 21 of the Tax Procedure Act
fi-he-141-2025.t: Amendment of section 21 of the Tax Code

fi-he-141-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the amendment of the Vehicle Act and related laws
fi-he-141-2026.s: The project will make the legislative changes required for the national implementation of the EU Regulation on NRMM and EURO 7, including smaller legislative changes for national vehicles, such as changes in support of the implementation of the State Productivity Programme or technical updating needs.
fi-he-141-2026.t: Act amending the vehicle law and related laws

fi-he-142-2025.f: Draft law of the Government to the Parliament of Finland on administrative cooperation in the field of taxation and amending the Act on the national implementation of the provisions of the Council Directive repealing Directive 77 / 799 / EEC and on the application of the Directive
fi-he-142-2025.s: Legislative proposals: Act on administrative cooperation in the field of taxation and amending the law on the national implementation of the provisions of the Council Directive repealing Directive 77 / 799 / EEC and on the application of the Directive
fi-he-142-2025.t: amending the Act on the National Implementation of the Provisions of the Council Directive on Administrative Cooperation in the field of Taxation and repealing Directive 77 / 799 / EEC and on the application of the Directive

fi-he-142-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland amending the Act on Authorised Industrial Ombudsmen
fi-he-142-2026.s: The proposal proposes to amend the procedure for applying for and granting authorisation under the Law on Authorised Industrial Ombudsmen, with a view to abolishing the authorisation of temporary agents, and to change the authorisation to remain in force for an indefinite period of time.
fi-he-142-2026.t: amending the Act on Authorised Industrial Ombudsmen

fi-he-143-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Foreign Law
fi-he-143-2024.s: The project prepares a proposal from the Government to amend the provisions of the Foreign Law on detention and entry ban, based on the entries in the Government Programme.

fi-he-143-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Vocational Education Act and related laws
fi-he-143-2025.s: The proposal proposes changes to the vocational training on-the-spot training, which proposes the payment of tuition fees to third-country nationals in secondary education.
fi-he-143-2025.t: amending the Vocational Education and Training Act and related laws

fi-he-143-2026.f: Government proposal for approval and entry into force of an agreement with Sweden on the final disposal of spent fuel and radioactive waste resulting from research activities transferred to the Parliament of Finland for research purposes
fi-he-143-2026.s: The proposal proposes that the Parliament of Finland approve the agreement between Finland and Sweden on the disposal of spent fuel and radioactive waste resulting from its research activities in Sweden and the enforcement of the provisions of the agreement in the field of legislation.
fi-he-143-2026.t: on the acceptance and entry into force of an agreement with Sweden on the disposal of spent fuel and radioactive waste resulting from research activities carried out for research purposes in the territory of the Kingdom of Sweden

fi-he-144-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 11 of the Vehicle Tax Act
fi-he-144-2024.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending section 11 of the Vehicle Tax Act
fi-he-144-2024.t: Act amending section 11 of the Vehicle Tax Act

fi-he-144-2025.f: Draft law of the Government to the Parliament of Finland amending the Act on the application of certain provisions of the European Union relating to State aid and related laws
fi-he-144-2025.s: Commission Regulation (EU) 2023/2831 requires a Member State to adopt measures for monitoring and reporting de minimis aid from 1.1.2026. Since the de minimis aid will continue to be granted in Finland, Finland must establish obligations under the Regulation from 1.1.2026.
fi-he-144-2025.t: amending the Act on the application of certain provisions of the European Union relating to State aid and related laws

fi-he-144-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on legislation on mixed insurance for unemployment benefits
fi-he-144-2026.s: According to section 4.3 of the Government Programme of Prime Minister Orpo, Social Security for Incentive Work, combined insurance for unemployment benefits would improve social security for both employees and entrepreneurs. In preparation, account will be taken of family and family carers and unemployment cover in the cultural and creative sectors, in accordance with section 5.4 of the Government Programme.
fi-he-144-2026.t: Legislation on combined insurance for unemployment benefits

fi-he-145-2024.f: Government proposal for amendment and temporary amendment of the Seamen Service Act
fi-he-145-2024.s: The Maritime Service Agency will act as a co-operative body for the appropriate organisation and harmonisation of the legal, voluntary maritime service activities in Finland and abroad. The State contribution to the activities of the Maritime Service Agency would be abolished.
fi-he-145-2024.t: Act amending and temporarily amending the Law on Seamen Services

fi-he-145-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation on security of supply and security of supply and amendment of the Safety Storage Act
fi-he-145-2025.s: The project will carry out an overall review of the security of supply legislation with a view to updating the regulatory framework.
fi-he-145-2025.t: Act on Security of Supply and Security of Service Centre and amending the Safety Storage Act

fi-he-145-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Tobacco Act
fi-he-145-2026.s: reform the regulation on tobacco smoke problems in housing companies and other communities, and make other necessary changes to the tobacco law;

fi-he-146-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on labour dispute settlement and the Conditions for certain industrial action
fi-he-146-2024.s: The project was launched by a seminar of 8 November 2023 and a consultation meeting which ended on 8 January 2024. After an event organised by the Minister of Labour on 16 January 2024, the working group from 1 February to 31 May 2024, the consultation round from 4 June to 30 July 2024, the Legislative Review Council from 11 August to 3 October, Law 816/2024 of 19 December 2025, entered into force from 1 January 2025.
fi-he-146-2024.t: Act amending the Act on labour dispute settlement and the Conditions for certain industrial action

fi-he-146-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the Promotion of Integration
fi-he-146-2025.s: The Government's proposal would amend the Act on the Promotion of Integration (681/2023) with regard to certain provisions, which would need to be corrected in the light of outdated references to law or clarification of the roles of public authorities.
fi-he-146-2025.t: amending the Act on the Promotion of Integration

fi-he-146-2026.f: Draft legislation and other laws extending the principle of the last pension institution of the occupational pension scheme to the Parliament of Finland
fi-he-146-2026.s: The purpose of the project is to extend the procedure of the last pension institution in the occupational pension scheme (the "Vilma procedure ') to cover the pension provision of persons covered by the Bank of Finland and the Financial Supervisory Authority and the pension provision of persons insured under the Åland Act on Public Sector Pensions.
fi-he-146-2026.t: Legislation to extend the principle of the last pension institution in the occupational pension scheme and other laws

fi-he-147-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on offshore wind power in the EEZ and related laws
fi-he-147-2024.s: The project will prepare a new law on offshore wind power in the EEZ, which is based on the fact that the current provisions of the EEZ Act are ill-suited to offshore wind power projects, including the choice of operator for maritime areas and the necessary permits.
fi-he-147-2024.t: Law on offshore wind power in the EEZ and related laws

fi-he-147-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation on the abolition of education allowance
fi-he-147-2025.s: Report of the Working Party on State Administrative Savings and Improvement needs related to the regulation of working life on the abolition of training allowance, consultation 1 January - 19 August 2025.
fi-he-147-2025.t: Legislation on the abolition of training allowance

fi-he-147-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for the adoption and entry into force of the Agreement on social security with the Eastern Republic of Uruguay
fi-he-147-2026.s: The project prepares a proposal from the government to the Parliament of Finland for the adoption and implementation of the agreement on social security with Uruguay.
fi-he-147-2026.t: Adoption and entry into force of the Agreement on social security with the Eastern Republic of Uruguay

fi-he-148-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending the Act on the recognition of private enterprises and other entities as members and partners of the European Network of Employment Services (EURES)
fi-he-148-2024.s: The proposal proposes to amend the Act on the recognition of private companies and other entities as members and partners of the European Network of Employment Services (EURES), and to amend the legal authority responsible so that in future KEHAC will be the responsible authority rather than the Ministry of Employment and the Economy.
fi-he-148-2024.t: amending the Act on the recognition of private enterprises and other entities as members and partners of the European Network of Employment Services (EURES)

fi-he-148-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending sections 7 and 11 of the Law on offshore wind power in the EEZ
fi-he-148-2025.s: The exclusion of the law on offshore wind in the EEZ would remove the restriction that only one company can participate in the competitive bidding of the EEZ from a single group, since it could restrict participation in the tender in a manner that is not in line with the interpretation practice of the Court of Justice of the European Union.
fi-he-148-2025.t: Amendment of sections 7 and 11 of the Law on offshore wind power in the EEZ

fi-he-148-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 7 of the Act on temporary measures to combat the use of means of entry
fi-he-148-2026.s: The project is designed to prepare a government proposal for interim measures to extend the law on the fight against the instrumented entry.
fi-he-148-2026.t: Amendment of section 7 of the Law on temporary measures to combat the use of means of entry

fi-he-149-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the amendment of the Health Act and related laws
fi-he-149-2024.s: Under Prime Minister Orpo's government's programme, the national composition of hospitals and on-call care and the division of labour into specialised medical care will be reformed.
fi-he-149-2024.t: Act on the amendment of the Health Care Act and related laws

fi-he-149-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Child Protection Act and related laws
fi-he-149-2025.s: Child protection legislation will be reformed in line with Prime Minister Petteri Orpo's government programme.
fi-he-149-2025.t: Act amending the Child Protection Act and related laws

fi-he-149-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the Export of Military Equipment
fi-he-149-2026.s: The project is preparing a proposal for a government proposal to amend the Law on the Export of Military Equipment (282/2012) which entered into force on 30 June 2012. It provides for the supervision and control of the export, transfer, brokering and transit of military equipment.
fi-he-149-2026.t: Act amending the Act on the Export of Military Equipment

fi-he-15-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for adoption and implementation of amendments to the Maritime Labour Convention and related laws
fi-he-15-2024.s: The project implements the amendments made to the ILO International Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) guidelines in 2022. The Government's proposal HE 15/2024 vp was issued on 7.3.2024, EV 45/2024, the laws confirmed on 13.6.2024, the Finnish Decree of 23.12.2024, i.e. by decree, the international entry into force of the amendments.
fi-he-15-2024.t: With a view to adopting and implementing amendments to the Maritime Labour Convention and related laws

fi-he-15-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the law on criminal offences in the Border Guard and related laws
fi-he-15-2025.s: The project is designed to prepare the government's proposal to amend the Law on Crime Prevention in the Border Guard (108/2018), which assesses the offences which the Border Guard is investigating, as well as secret means of obtaining information and coercive measures.
fi-he-15-2025.t: Act amending the Law on Criminal Sanctions in the Border Guard and related laws

fi-he-15-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on Transport Services and related laws
fi-he-15-2026.s: The government programme is geared towards the implementation of a legislative project on taxis, with the aim of strengthening consumer confidence in taxi transport, promoting access to taxis, taking account of different customer groups throughout the country, and improving the control of taxis and eliminating the black economy.
fi-he-15-2026.t: Act amending the Transport Services Act and related laws

fi-he-150-2024.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland amending the Act on the financing of unemployment benefits and the title of Chapter 7 and section 27 of the Unemployment Insurance Act
fi-he-150-2024.s: The proposal would set unemployment insurance contributions for 2025.
fi-he-150-2024.t: amending the Act on the financing of unemployment benefits and the title of Chapter 7 and section 27 of the Unemployment Insurance Act

fi-he-150-2025.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Health Insurance Act and related laws
fi-he-150-2025.s: The provisions of the Health Insurance Act (1224/2004) and the State Council Regulation (1335/2004) on the implementation of the Health Insurance Act on special pregnancy allowances will be reformed to reflect national and international provisions on the protection of pregnant workers, workers who have recently given birth and breastfeeding.
fi-he-150-2025.t: Act amending the Health Insurance Act and related laws

fi-he-150-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to change the municipal law
fi-he-150-2026.s: The draft law would introduce a provision in the Municipal Act that the Ministry of Finance would be responsible for the general direction and monitoring of the municipalities' preparation to the extent that it was not within the remit of the other Ministry. In addition, some other clarifications would be made in the Municipal Act.
fi-he-150-2026.t: Act amending the Local Government Act

fi-he-151-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Climate Act
fi-he-151-2024.s: The obligation of the municipality to draw up a climate plan on the Climate Act (423/2022) is repealed, and the need for legislative change is based on the entry in Annex B to the Financial Decisions of Prime Minister Petteri Orpo, which provides for the withdrawal of the obligation for municipalities to draw up climate plans by means of a legislative amendment.

fi-he-151-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 13 of the Chemicals Act
fi-he-151-2025.s: It is proposed to amend the chemicals law to give Customs the right to intervene by means of controls in cases where consumers import illicit biocidal products or treated articles from the EU internal market for their own use.
fi-he-151-2025.t: Act amending section 13 of the Chemicals Act

fi-he-151-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend sections 119 and 124 of the Income Tax Act and sections 7 and 15 of the Tax Act on Income Tax Limited
fi-he-151-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending sections 119 and 124 of the Income Tax Act; Act limited to sections 7 and 15 of the Income Tax Act
fi-he-151-2026.t: amending sections 119 and 124 of the Income Tax Act and sections 7 and 15 of the Income Tax Act to a limited extent

fi-he-152-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 5 of the Code of Justice and Court Fees
fi-he-152-2024.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending the legal order; Act amending section 5 of the Law on Courts' Charges
fi-he-152-2024.t: Act amending section 5 of the Law on Courts and Court Charges

fi-he-152-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the church law
fi-he-152-2026.s: In November 2016, when the meeting of the church assembly decided to discuss Act 1/2016 on the development of the parish election procedures and the proposal of the Diocese Council to postpone the date of the parish election 3/2016 and to send the representative initiative and the diocese council proposal to the church government for preparation. Some of the proposed changes were implemented now.
fi-he-152-2026.t: The law of changing the church law

fi-he-153-2025.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the Restructuring of the Company and section 21 of Chapter 11 of the Securities Markets Act
fi-he-153-2025.s: Under the government programme, the restructuring measures for enterprises will be diversified through the introduction of debt conversion.
fi-he-153-2025.t: amending the Act on the Restructuring of an Enterprise and section 21 of Chapter 11 of the Securities Markets Act

fi-he-153-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for the approval and entry into force of an agreement on air transport with the Federative Republic of Brazil
fi-he-153-2026.s: The agreement is a bilateral air transport agreement which, inter alia, provides for the possibility and conditions under which the parties may designate airlines to exercise the traffic rights conferred by the agreement, which provides for the rights and obligations of airlines in the exercise of their traffic.
fi-he-153-2026.t: Approval and entry into force of the Agreement on Air Transport with the Federative Republic of Brazil

fi-he-154-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Law on the State Budget and related laws
fi-he-154-2024.s: The current state finance reporting has been found insufficient for the overall economy, and it is therefore proposed to provide for the presentation of consolidated government accounts in the context of the state accounts, covering not only the state budget but also the non-budgetary state funds.
fi-he-154-2024.t: Act amending the Law on the State Budget and related laws

fi-he-154-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for the approval and entry into force of the Agreement on Air Transport with the Republic of Rwanda
fi-he-154-2025.s: The agreement is a bilateral air transport agreement which, inter alia, provides for the possibility and conditions under which the parties may designate airlines to exercise the traffic rights conferred by the agreement, which provides for the rights and obligations of airlines in the exercise of their traffic.
fi-he-154-2025.t: With a view to approving and implementing the Agreement on Air Transport with the Republic of Rwanda

fi-he-154-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for the approval and entry into force of the Agreement on Air Transport with the Republic of Peru
fi-he-154-2026.s: The agreement is a bilateral air transport agreement which, inter alia, provides for the possibility and conditions under which the parties may designate airlines to exercise the traffic rights conferred by the agreement, which provides for the rights and obligations of airlines in the course of their activities.
fi-he-154-2026.t: With a view to the adoption and entry into force of the Agreement on Air Transport with the Republic of Peru

fi-he-155-2025.f: Proposal of the Government to the Parliament of Finland for the approval and entry into force of the Agreement between the Government of the Republic of Finland and the Government of the United States of America on the gainful employment of dependants of official employees and amending sections 81a and 81b of the Foreign Law
fi-he-155-2025.s: Agreement between the Government of the Republic of Finland and the Government of the United States of America on the employment of dependants of official workers (family and spouse agreement) and the adoption and enforcement of the related Act of Enforcement. Furthermore, the proposal proposes to amend sections 81a and 81b of the Foreign Law.
fi-he-155-2025.t: For the adoption and entry into force of an agreement between the Government of the Republic of Finland and the Government of the United States of America on the gainful employment of dependants of official workers and amending sections 81a and 81b of the Alien Act

fi-he-155-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Act on the Energy Certificate of the Building and the Construction Act
fi-he-155-2026.s: The project amends the legislation on energy certification in order to comply with the requirements of the recast Directive on energy efficiency of buildings (2024/1275 / EU).
fi-he-155-2026.t: Act amending the Act on the Energy Certificate of the Building and the Law on Construction

fi-he-156-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to repeal certain provisions of the Act on Excise Tax on Electricity and Certain Fuels
fi-he-156-2025.s: Legislative proposals: Act repealing certain provisions of the Act on Excise Tax on Electricity and Certain Fuels
fi-he-156-2025.t: Act repealing certain provisions of the Act on Excise Tax on Electricity and Certain Fuels

fi-he-156-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland amending the Act on Housing Rights
fi-he-156-2026.s: The project is preparing provisions for the Housing Rights Act on the liberalisation of housing restrictions in two specific circumstances, including the abolition of the number of legal units in the selection of residents, in order to ensure the sustainability of the right of residence system in changing market conditions.
fi-he-156-2026.t: Amendment of the Act on Housing Rights

fi-he-157-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the Prevention of Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing and related laws
fi-he-157-2024.s: The proposal proposes to amend the Act on the Prevention of Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing, as well as certain other laws to improve the exchange of information in the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing, as well as to address other identified needs for change.
fi-he-157-2024.t: amending the Act on the Prevention of Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing and related Acts

fi-he-157-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation on electronic service in the tax administration
fi-he-157-2025.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending section 26c of the Tax Procedure; Act amending section 56 of the Law on the Tax Procedure for Own-initiative Taxes; Act amending section 71 of the Tax Recovery Act; Act amending section 6a of the Advance Recovery Act
fi-he-157-2025.t: Legislation on electronic service in the tax administration

fi-he-157-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on legislation implementing the Environmental Crime Directive
fi-he-157-2026.s: In spring 2024, the European Union adopted a new directive on environmental offences, which contains minimum provisions on, inter alia, criminal offences and penalties, in preparation for the national implementation of the directive, with a two-year period for its implementation.
fi-he-157-2026.t: Legislation on the implementation of the Environmental Crime Directive

fi-he-158-2025.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to amend the legislation on the grounds of dismissal relating to the person of the employee
fi-he-158-2025.s: The Board of Directors has entered into an amendment to the regulation of the person-related grounds for termination of the contract of employment for a reasonable reason in the future. "The term of office of the working group from 2 September to 31 December 2024, consultation from 24 February to 7 April 2025, opinion of the Evaluation Council of 6 October 2025, HE 158/2025 of 23 October 2025, Law of 22 October 2025, effective from 1 January 2026.
fi-he-158-2025.t: Amendment of the legislation on grounds of dismissal relating to the person of the employee

fi-he-158-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Border Guard Act and related laws
fi-he-158-2026.s: The project is designed to identify and prepare the necessary changes in the normal conditions legislation to support the preparation of the Border Guard to meet the requirements of the changed security and operating environment.
fi-he-158-2026.t: Act amending the Border Guard Act and related laws

fi-he-159-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on Health Care and the Act on the Processing of Customer Data in Social and Health Care
fi-he-159-2025.s: The project aims at enabling the social and health care focus to be shifted from the services of repair to early support and prevention, and to develop legislation enabling the anticipation of service needs, in particular by enabling technology to be exploited.
fi-he-159-2025.t: Act amending the Health Care Act and the Law on the Processing of Customer Data in Social and Health Care

fi-he-159-2026.f: Proposal of the Government to the Parliament of Finland for the adoption and entry into force of the Agreement amending the Protocol amending the Protocol on double taxation of income and wealth taxes with Switzerland
fi-he-159-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending the Protocol amending the Agreement and the Protocol on double taxation of income and wealth taxes with Switzerland; Protocol amending the Agreement and Protocol between the Republic of Finland and the Swiss Confederation on double taxation of income and wealth taxes in Helsinki on 16 December 1991, as amended by the Protocols of 19 April 2006, 22 September 2009 and 18 September 2012, as amended by the Helsinki Protocol of 19 April 2006, 22 September 2009 and 18 September 2012
fi-he-159-2026.t: With a view to the adoption and entry into force of the Agreement with Switzerland and the Protocol amending the Protocol on double taxation of income and wealth taxes

fi-he-16-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation on the new gambling system
fi-he-16-2025.s: The aim of the project is to clarify the reform of the gambling system in line with the government programme and to prepare a proposal for a regulatory basis for the transition to the licensing system.
fi-he-16-2025.t: Legislation on the new gambling system

fi-he-16-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending the Law on Police Administration, the Law on Police University of Applied Sciences and Section 10 of Chapter 1 of the Police Act
fi-he-16-2026.s: The objective of creating a police reserve is to secure police capabilities in all situations.
fi-he-16-2026.t: Act amending section 10 of Chapter 1 of the Law on Police Administration, the Law on Police Academy of Applied Sciences and the Law on Police Administration

fi-he-160-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on student support and the Act on General Housing Support
fi-he-160-2024.s: According to the government's public finance plan, students will be returned from general housing support to the housing allowance on 1 August 2025. The project implements a housing allowance that is favourable to shared housing and economically attractive according to the government programme.
fi-he-160-2024.t: Act amending the Act on Student Aid and the Act on General Housing Assistance

fi-he-160-2025.f: Draft laws of the Government amending the Waste Act, the Environmental Protection Act, the Administrative Law and the Court of Justice Act
fi-he-160-2025.s: The proposal would amend the Waste Act, the Environmental Protection Act, the Administrative Law and the Court of Justice Act, which provides for a new authorisation procedure for the classification of a substance or object as a by-product or waste.
fi-he-160-2025.t: Act amending the Waste Act, the Environmental Protection Act, the Administrative Law and the Court of Justice Act

fi-he-160-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the Qualification of Studies abroad and the Recognition of Professional Qualifications
fi-he-160-2026.s: Propose the adoption of a law on the qualifications of foreign students for a regulated post ("the Foreign Education Act ').
fi-he-160-2026.t: amending the Act on the Qualification of Studies abroad and the Recognition of Professional Qualifications

fi-he-161-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the experimentation of vocational education and training activities and related laws
fi-he-161-2024.s: The proposal proposes that an experiment on the management of vocational training should be carried out between 1 January 2026 and 31 December 2033, and that the funding system for vocational training and support for learning should be reformed.
fi-he-161-2024.t: Law on experimenting with vocational training activities and related laws

fi-he-161-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to change the law on reindeer husbandry and related laws
fi-he-161-2025.s: The project will draw up legislative proposals for implementing the proposals of the two previous working groups on reindeer husbandry management and operating plans and assess the need for a revision of the reindeer husbandry law to improve the effectiveness of the provisions on reindeer husbandry and control and prepare proposals for amendments.
fi-he-161-2025.t: Act amending the reindeer husbandry law and related laws

fi-he-161-2026.f: Proposal of the Government to the Parliament of Finland amending the Act on the conditions of entry and residence of third-country nationals on grounds of research, study, traineeships and voluntary activities
fi-he-161-2026.s: The project will introduce legal changes for third-country nationals concerning secondary students and all students and students' family members.
fi-he-161-2026.t: amending the Act on the conditions of entry and residence of third-country nationals on the basis of research, studies, traineeships and voluntary activities

fi-he-162-2025.f: Government bill amending section 2 of the Act on the Civil Engineering of the Municipality and section 2 of the Act on the Reinforcements of Trade
fi-he-162-2025.s: The proposal proposes to amend the Act on the Civil Property Engineer and the Act on Trade Reinforcements.
fi-he-162-2025.t: Amendment of section 2 of the Municipal Real Estate Engineer Act and of section 2 of the Act on Commercial Reinforcements

fi-he-162-2026.f: Draft laws of the Board of Directors amending the Act on Pension Foundations and Pension funds and related laws
fi-he-162-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending the Pension Funds and Pension Funds Act; Act amending section 2 of Chapter 1 of the Insurance Funds Act; Act amending section 10 of Chapter 1 of the Pension Funds and Pension Funds Act; Act amending section 4 of the Financial Supervision Act
fi-he-162-2026.t: Act amending the Act on Pension Funds and Pension funds and related laws

fi-he-163-2024.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland as a law amending section 35 of the Act on the State Contribution of the Local Government to Basic Services and section 17 of the Basic Education Act
fi-he-163-2024.s: The proposal implements a government programme record to increase the household allowance for private training providers to 100% and to harmonise their obligations, with the aim of bringing into force the legislative changes to 1 August 2025.
fi-he-163-2024.t: Amendment of section 35 of the Law on the State Contribution to Basic Services of the Municipality and section 17 of the Basic Education Act

fi-he-163-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to change the regulation of terrorist offences
fi-he-163-2025.s: Given the nature of the crime, there is no comprehensive assessment of the relationship between the terrorist offences that are being sanctioned and the regulatory package; due to the nature of the crime, adequate coverage of the regulation must be ensured, while at the same time respecting basic and human rights obligations and Finland's binding obligations, for example international humanitarian law obligations.
fi-he-163-2025.t: Amendment of the regulation on terrorist offences

fi-he-163-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation on the development of pharmacy activities
fi-he-163-2026.s: Implement the government programme records of Prime Minister Petteri Orpo to reform pharmacy regulation responsibly and gradually to ensure high-quality and safe pharmacy services throughout Finland.
fi-he-163-2026.t: Legislation on the development of pharmaceutical activities

fi-he-164-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the laws on certain surface area and animal-based subsidies
fi-he-164-2024.s: From the beginning of 2025, the government's proposal would include a requirement of social conditionality for EU Member States to become compulsory and be part of the EU's total or partial funding of surface area and animal-based payments.
fi-he-164-2024.t: amending the laws on certain surface area and animal-based payments

fi-he-164-2025.f: Draft legislation by the Board of Directors on the allocation of income to a permanent establishment
fi-he-164-2025.s: The proposal proposes amendments to the Income Tax Act, the Act on the Taxation of Business Income and the Act on the Elimination of International Double Taxation, with the aim of enabling Finland to introduce in its tax treaties an OECD Model Tax Convention 2010 Business Income Article.
fi-he-164-2025.t: Regulation on the allocation of revenue to a permanent establishment

fi-he-164-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the energy performance of buildings
fi-he-164-2026.s: The Law would implement the requirements of Article 9 of the recast Directive on the energy efficiency of buildings (EPBD) on the energy performance of existing non-residential buildings and the requirements of Article 10 on the introduction of solar energy in buildings.
fi-he-164-2026.t: As a law on the energy performance of buildings

fi-he-165-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 12 of the Animal Welfare Act and the Act on the pursuit of a veterinary profession
fi-he-165-2024.s: It proposes to amend the Animal Welfare Act and section 12 of the Law on the pursuit of the veterinary profession.
fi-he-165-2024.t: amending section 12 of the Animal Welfare Act and the Act on the pursuit of a veterinary profession

fi-he-165-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending sections 46 and 99 of the Mining Act
fi-he-165-2025.s: The project is preparing amendments to the Mining Act, which allow for the updating of permits granted before 2011 and the entry into force of the existing Mining Act, in line with the requirements of the current legal environment.
fi-he-165-2025.t: amending sections 46 and 99 of the Mining Act

fi-he-165-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend Chapter 2 of the Police Act, the Government of the Republic of Finland and the Government of the Kingdom of Sweden on the Convention on Border Police Cooperation and the Law on Police Assistance by the Defence Forces
fi-he-165-2026.s: The aim of the proposal is to improve the ability of the police to address the security threats posed by unmanned vehicles and to update regulation in line with technological developments.
fi-he-165-2026.t: Act amending the Act on the Convention on Police Cooperation in the Border Region between Chapter 2 of the Police Act, the Government of the Republic of Finland and the Government of the Kingdom of Sweden and the Act on the Civil Service Assistance of the Defence Forces to the Police

fi-he-166-2024.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland amending the Act on the Management of Risk of Foreign Species
fi-he-166-2024.s: A provision would be added to the law to allow the exploitation of unmanned aerial vessels, i.e. drones, in the catching of alien species mammals, and the use of drones would in particular improve the fishing of raccoon dogs under island conditions, and the proposal would also extend the maximum transitional period for new alien species from two to three years.
fi-he-166-2024.t: amending the Act on the Management of Risks of Alien Species

fi-he-166-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Waste Act
fi-he-166-2025.s: The project prepares a proposal from the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Waste Act, which would change the cost liability of producers of certain disposable plastic products for certain municipal waste management and cleaning activities.
fi-he-166-2025.t: Act on the amendment of the Waste Act

fi-he-166-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for archipelago law
fi-he-166-2026.s: Preparation of a reform of the Act on the Promotion of Archipelago Development (Archipelago Act), which concerns both the structure and content of the Act, the current Act on Archipelago is from 1981 and has not been systematically updated since entry into force.

fi-he-167-2024.f: Draft laws of the Government amending sections 1 and 2 of the Meteorological Institute Act and section 11 of the Defence Forces Act
fi-he-167-2024.s: Preparation of legislative amendments necessary for the establishment of the Space Space Centre for the Government's proposal for a law amending the Meteorological Institute Act (212/2018).
fi-he-167-2024.t: Act amending sections 1 and 2 of the Meteorological Institute Act and section 11 of the Defence Forces Act

fi-he-167-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for laws on the management of public finances and the Economic Policy Assessment Council and related laws
fi-he-167-2025.s: In April 2024, the EU fiscal rules were reformed, containing both directly applicable provisions and the need for changes to national legislation, and the Ministry of Finance has set up a Working Party on the Reform of Fiscal Rules in December 2023.
fi-he-167-2025.t: Acts on the management of public finances and on the Economic Policy Assessment Council and related laws

fi-he-167-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the Processing of Customer Data in Social and Health Care
fi-he-167-2026.s: The Board's proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Customer Information Act concerning the notification of the customer to the police for threat assessment and prevention of a threatening act.
fi-he-167-2026.t: Act amending the Act on the Processing of Customer Data in Social and Health Care

fi-he-168-2024.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland amending section 2 of the Act on the financially supported development of professional skills and the Law on the Replacement of Education
fi-he-168-2024.s: In the spring 2024 framework, the Board of Directors decided to abolish the employer's educational allowance, which entails changes to the law on financially supported vocational skills development and the law on the replacement of training.
fi-he-168-2024.t: amending section 2 of the Act on the financially supported development of professional skills and the Act on the replacement of training

fi-he-168-2025.f: Proposal of the Government to the Parliament of Finland to supplement the proposal of the Government amending section 72 of the Tobacco Tax Act and the Excise Tax Act (HE 96/2025 vp)
fi-he-168-2025.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending section 72 of the Excise Tax Act
fi-he-168-2025.t: supplementing the Government proposal amending section 72 of the Tobacco Tax Act and the Excise Tax Act (HE 96/2025 vp)

fi-he-168-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending the Act on Health Care, the Law on Social Care Professionals and the Act on Health Professionals
fi-he-168-2026.s: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on Health Care, the Law on Social Care Professionals and the Act on Health Professionals (Two-step Psychotherapy Training)
fi-he-168-2026.t: Act amending the Health Care Act, the Law on Social Services Professionals and the Law on Health Professionals

fi-he-169-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending sections 1 and 24 of the Act on the conditions of entry and residence of third-country nationals for the purpose of working as seasonal workers
fi-he-169-2024.s: The task of the working group is to prepare legislative amendments to the seasonal labour law and regulation so that it is possible for wild berry collectors to enter the country in the future with authorisation for seasonal work.
fi-he-169-2024.t: amending sections 1 and 24 of the Act on the conditions of entry and residence of third-country nationals for the purpose of working as seasonal workers

fi-he-169-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the Management of Information of Public Administration as archiving and law
fi-he-169-2025.s: The legislation on archives is being reformed as a result of changes in the operating and regulatory environment, which does not take account of the changes resulting from digitalisation, and must be compatible with the law on public access and the law on data management.
fi-he-169-2025.t: As a archive and law amending the Law on the Management of Information of the Public Administration

fi-he-169-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the Social Insurance Institution
fi-he-169-2026.s: A new section 20c is proposed to protect employees of the Social Insurance Institution from threats and harassment.
fi-he-169-2026.t: Act amending the Act on the Social Insurance Institution

fi-he-17-2025.f: Presentation by the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland of laws amending the Income Tax Act and certain other tax laws
fi-he-17-2025.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending the Income Tax Act; Act amending section 4 of the withholding tax Act; Act amending the Tax Procedure Act; Limited Act amending section 16a of the Income Tax Act
fi-he-17-2025.t: Act amending the Income Tax Act and certain other tax laws

fi-he-17-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland as a complement to the EU regulation on cross-border electronic identification, trust services and European digital identity
fi-he-17-2026.s: The aim of the group is to prepare the legislative changes necessary to fulfil the obligations of the revised eIDAS Regulation.
fi-he-17-2026.t: Cross-border e-identification, trust services and European digital identity regulation as complementary legislation

fi-he-170-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Energy Efficiency Act
fi-he-170-2024.s: The Government's proposal would implement Article 12 (1) of the revised Energy Efficiency Directive (EU) 2023/1791, which requires the owners and operators of data centres to make certain data centres and their activities publicly available.
fi-he-170-2024.t: Act amending the Energy Efficiency Act

fi-he-170-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for the protection of persons involved in public debate against cross-border harassment actions
fi-he-170-2025.s: The project implements Directive (EU) 2024/1069 on the protection of persons involved in public debate against manifestly unfounded claims or misused legal proceedings ("Strategic actions against participation in public debate").
fi-he-170-2025.t: Protection of persons involved in public debate against cross-border harassment actions

fi-he-170-2026.f: Presentation of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland for the Act on Urban Development and related Acts
fi-he-170-2026.s: The aim of the project is to update the regulatory package for local authorities' land policy, implementation of formulas, maintenance and clean-up of streets and other public areas, and to implement the relevant entries of the government programme.
fi-he-170-2026.t: Urban Development Act and related laws

fi-he-171-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 22 of the Health Care Act
fi-he-171-2024.s: It proposes to amend the health care law so that, in the welfare area, there would be no obligation in the future to ensure that its resident or health centre patient receives a certificate or statement as provided for in the driving licence law.
fi-he-171-2024.t: Act amending section 22 of the Health Care Act

fi-he-171-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Annex to the Tobacco Tax Act
fi-he-171-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending the Annex to the Tobacco Tax Act
fi-he-171-2026.t: amending the Annex to the Tobacco Tax Act

fi-he-172-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the Administration of Customs
fi-he-172-2025.s: The proposal proposes to amend the Act on the Administration of Customs. No changes are proposed to the duties or establishments of the Customs. The amendments concern provisions on the Rules of Procedure, the powers of the Court of Justice and the more detailed provisions of the Customs Code.
fi-he-172-2025.t: Act amending the Customs Administration Act

fi-he-172-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending section 4 of the Act on the taxation of alcohol and alcoholic beverages and the Annex
fi-he-172-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending section 4 of and the Annex to the Act on the taxation of alcoholic beverages and alcoholic beverages
fi-he-172-2026.t: amending section 4 and the Annex of the Act on the taxation of alcohol and alcoholic beverages

fi-he-173-2021.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for additional legislation on the Entry / Exit System and the European Travel Information and Authorisation System
fi-he-173-2021.s: The project will prepare the legislative changes required by the Regulations on the Entry / Exit System (EES) and the European Travel Information and Authorisation System (ETIAS).
fi-he-173-2021.t: Complementary legislation on the border crossing information system and the European Travel Information and Authorisation System

fi-he-173-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the amendment of the Alcohol Act
fi-he-173-2024.s: Amendment of the alcohol law, home delivery of alcohol
fi-he-173-2024.t: Law on the amendment of the Alcohol Act

fi-he-173-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the hunting law
fi-he-173-2025.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending the hunting law
fi-he-173-2025.t: Act on the amendment of the hunting law

fi-he-173-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the annex to the Vehicle Tax Act
fi-he-173-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending Annex to the Vehicle Tax Act
fi-he-173-2026.t: Act amending the Annex to the Vehicle Tax Act

fi-he-174-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend Chapter 3 Section 3 of the Health Insurance Act
fi-he-174-2024.s: The purpose of the project is to implement the necessary legislative changes in order to implement the new Kela compensation model under the Government Programme.
fi-he-174-2024.t: Act amending Section 3 of Chapter 3 of the Health Insurance Act

fi-he-174-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on Health Care Professionals and the Law on Social Care Professionals
fi-he-174-2025.s: The Government's proposal amends the laws of health and social care professionals so that the legislation would allow the reception and delivery of international assistance in social and health care in accordance with the Government Programme of Petteri Orpo. In addition, the necessary technical changes will be made due to the reform of the regional government of the State.
fi-he-174-2025.t: Act amending the Act on Health Care Professionals and the Law on Social Care Professionals

fi-he-174-2026.f: The Board's proposal to the Parliament of Finland for laws on the income tax scale and on the modification of the Income Tax Act of 2027 and other tax laws
fi-he-174-2026.s: The proposal provides for the 2027 income tax scale and other income tax bases.
fi-he-174-2026.t: Act on the income tax scale and on the amendment of the Income Tax Act of 2027 and other tax laws

fi-he-175-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend Chapters 3 and 11 of the Law on the Organisation of Water Management and the Management of the Sea, the Environmental Protection Act and the Water Act
fi-he-175-2024.s: The work of the working group will prepare proposals for legislation on the environmental objectives and derogations from the environmental objectives of water management, in particular the Law on the organisation of water and sea management, which will be implemented by the Ministry of the Environment and the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry in their fields of activity.
fi-he-175-2024.t: As a law amending Chapters 3 and 11 of the Act on the Organisation of Water Management and the Management of the Sea, the Environmental Protection Act and the Water Act

fi-he-175-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation on the European electronic evidence order and the retention order
fi-he-175-2025.s: The E- evidence Regulation (EU) 2023/1543) and the e-evidence Directive (EU) 2023/1544) provide for a European order for presentation and retention of electronic evidence in criminal matters and for the appointment of legal representatives for the collection of electronic evidence in criminal matters.
fi-he-175-2025.t: European legislation on the European order for the presentation and retention of electronic evidence

fi-he-175-2026.f: Draft State Budget for the Government's the Parliament of Finland for 2027

fi-he-176-2024.f: Draft laws of the Government amending sections 37 and 38 of the Environmental Damage Fund Act and repealing section 5 (15) of the Financial Supervision Act
fi-he-176-2024.s: The Government's proposal proposes to clarify the transitional provisions of the Environmental Damage Fund Act (1262/2022), which repeals the Oil Protection Fund Act (1406/2004) and the Environmental Damage Insurance Act (81/1998).
fi-he-176-2024.t: As a law amending sections 37 and 38 of the Environmental Damage Fund Act and repealing section 5 (15) of the Financial Supervision Act

fi-he-176-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Tax Procedure Act and certain other laws
fi-he-176-2025.s: The tax procedure and certain other tax laws would include an authorisation provision allowing for a temporary extension of the tax-related time limits in the event of a serious disturbance by a decree of the Council of State.
fi-he-176-2025.t: amending the Tax Procedure Act and certain other laws

fi-he-176-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland as a law amending the Act amending and temporarily amending the Act on the State Contribution to Basic Services of the municipality and the Act on the State Contribution to the Municipal Basic Services
fi-he-176-2026.s: The proposal would provide for a percentage of the State participation in the municipality's basic services for 2027. The impact of the index increase would be limited by 2.8%. Furthermore, the allocation of the EUR 75 million reduction would be continued for an indefinite period of time, with the reduction being equal in percentage to the share of the municipality's basic services.
fi-he-176-2026.t: Amendment of the Act amending and temporarily amending the Act on the State Contribution to Basic Services of the Municipality and the Act on the State Contribution to Basic Services of the Municipality

fi-he-177-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the School Travel Support Act
fi-he-177-2024.s: In accordance with the Government's budgetary plan for the period 2025-2028, the right to travel to school is limited to students eligible for free education.
fi-he-177-2024.t: Act amending the School Travel Support Act

fi-he-177-2025.f: Draft legislation by the Government to supplement the Regulation on classification activities related to the environment, society and good governance to the Parliament of Finland
fi-he-177-2025.s: The aim of the project is to make the necessary changes to national legislation following the Regulation on classification activities in the field of environment, society and good governance (ESG), which sets out information obligations, organisational requirements and a control framework at EU level for ESG-level.
fi-he-177-2025.t: The Regulation on classification activities related to the environment, society and good governance as complementary legislation

fi-he-177-2026.f: Presentation of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland of the laws governing the privileges and privileges
fi-he-177-2026.s: Proposed laws: the Student Benefits Act; the Act amending the School Travel Support Act; the Act amending section 9c of the Act on National Educational, Educational and Qualifications Registers; the Act amending the compulsory education Act
fi-he-177-2026.t: For the purposes of this Chapter, the following definitions apply:

fi-he-178-2022.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 52 of the Health and Social Welfare Act (AMK traineeship allowance)
fi-he-178-2022.s: The Health and Social Welfare Act proposes to provide for training in welfare areas, Helsinki City, the HUS Group and private service providers in the form of state funding.
fi-he-178-2022.t: Act amending section 52 of the Health and Social Welfare Act and the Social Welfare Act (AMK traineeship allowance)

fi-he-178-2024.f: Draft laws of the Government amending the Law on the Protection of the Marine Environment and certain other laws and adopting and implementing amendments to the Hong Kong Convention, the MARPOL Annexes and the Annexes to the London Protocol
fi-he-178-2024.s: The the Parliament of Finland will be presented with ship-emission bans in Finnish territorial waters under the Government Programme, the so-called "FuelEU Maritime and Distribution Infrastructure Regulations" as well as the adoption of the Hong Kong Convention and the adoption of the amendments to the MARPOL Convention and the London Protocol.
fi-he-178-2024.t: Act amending the Law on the Protection of the Marine Environment and certain other laws and adopting and implementing the amendments to the Hong Kong Convention, the MARPOL Annexes and the Annexes to the London Protocol

fi-he-178-2025.f: Draft legislation of the Government to the Parliament of Finland amending section 10 of the Act on the implementation of certain European Union and national agricultural aid, sections 6 and 8 of the Act on direct payments to farmers in the European Union and section 5 of the Act on certain payments for rural development
fi-he-178-2025.s: The proposal proposes to amend the provisions on the management of the eligible area, the introduction of a permanent grassland restoration procedure and the date of the administrative audit of certain environmental agreements, with a view to clarifying the role of municipalities in the case of the merger of aid applications, which are intended to enter into force as soon as possible.
fi-he-178-2025.t: amending Articles 10 of the Act on the implementation of certain European Union and national agricultural aid, 6 and 8 of the Act on direct payments to farmers in the European Union and section 5 of the Act on Certain Compensation for Rural Development

fi-he-178-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Law on Temporary Support for Forests
fi-he-178-2026.s: The aim is to re-introduce the afforestation aid scheme for idling areas for the period 2027-2029. The Forest Aid Amendment Act is to enter into force from the beginning of 2027 and the application of the aid application would be opened in the forest centre from the end of March 2027.
fi-he-178-2026.t: amending the Law on Temporary Support for Forests

fi-he-179-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the amendment of the Foreign Law and related laws
fi-he-179-2024.s: The working group is preparing for the employment situation of HE, where a foreign worker has to leave Finland when the employment relationship ends and has not entered into a new employment relationship within three months. In addition, the employer is required to report unemployment to the Immigration Service and the right to work on labour permits is extended to labour shortages.
fi-he-179-2024.t: Act amending the Foreign Law and related laws

fi-he-179-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation implementing the Cyber Sustainability Regulation
fi-he-179-2025.s: The project will prepare further and more detailed national provisions necessary for the national implementation of the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA).
fi-he-179-2025.t: Legislation on the implementation of the Cyber Sustainability Regulation

fi-he-179-2026.f: Presentation by the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland of the amendment of the Act on the organisation of employment services and the Unemployment Security Act
fi-he-179-2026.s: The legislative project is intended to prepare a proposal from the government to amend the regulations on wage support laid down in the Labour Services Organisation Act (380/2023), which aims at increasing the discretion of the employment services and simplifying the regulatory environment.
fi-he-179-2026.t: amending the Act on the organisation of employment services and the Unemployment Security Act

fi-he-18-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 7 of the Act on temporary measures to combat the use of means of entry
fi-he-18-2025.s: The project is designed to prepare a government proposal for interim measures to extend the law on the fight against the instrumented entry.
fi-he-18-2025.t: Amendment of section 7 of the Law on temporary measures to combat the use of means of entry

fi-he-18-2026.f: Presentation by the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland of the terms and conditions of the affiliated position of the Science Information Technology Centre Oy, the joint use of its research infrastructure and the obligation to prepare
fi-he-18-2026.s: The proposal provides for the adoption of the Law on the Conditions of Stakeholder Status of the Science Information Technology Centre Ltd, the joint use of its research infrastructure and the obligation to prepare.
fi-he-18-2026.t: Act on the conditions of the affiliated status of a public limited company known as the Science Information Technology Centre Oy, the joint use of its research infrastructure and the obligation to prepare

fi-he-180-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending section 41 of the Election Act
fi-he-180-2024.s: It proposes amending the electoral law to allow the Ministry of Justice to provide for the numbering of candidates at the same time in the elections, so that candidates from different elections have clearly distinguished numbers.
fi-he-180-2024.t: Act amending section 41 of the Election Act

fi-he-180-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending the Act on interest subsidies for rental housing loans and housing loans
fi-he-180-2025.s: The regulation of long-term interest rate support will be amended so that, instead of the current 95% ceiling, the production of student housing could receive a maximum of 100% of the interest rate subsidy.
fi-he-180-2025.t: amending the Act on interest subsidies for rental housing loans and housing loans

fi-he-180-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Social Welfare Act and related laws
fi-he-180-2026.s: reform social welfare legislation to increase the capacity of welfare regions to organise and organise services more flexibly and with a more customer-oriented approach, taking into account regional specificities and individual customer needs;
fi-he-180-2026.t: Act on the amendment of the Social Welfare Act and related laws

fi-he-181-2025.f: Proposal of the Government to the Parliament of Finland for the adoption and entry into force of the Agreement between the Republic of Finland and the Eastern Republic of Uruguay on the gainful employment of members of the family of diplomatic, consular or international representation staff
fi-he-181-2025.s: The proposal proposes that the Parliament of Finland approve the Agreement between the Republic of Finland and the Eastern Republic of Uruguay on the employment of family members of their diplomatic, consular or international delegations and the Act of Accession of the Agreement
fi-he-181-2025.t: on the approval and entry into force of the Agreement between the Republic of Finland and the Eastern Republic of Uruguay on the gainful employment of members of the family of staff of diplomatic missions, consular missions or of representatives of international intergovernmental organisations

fi-he-181-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend and temporarily amend the Law on Social and Health Care Control and to amend section 6 of the Grey Economic Clearing House Act
fi-he-181-2026.s: The Law on Social and Health Care is amended to the extent deemed necessary by the ex post evaluation of the Act, and the obligation for the service provider to provide the language skills of its staff is laid down, and section 6 of the Grey Economic Clearing House Act is amended.
fi-he-181-2026.t: Amendment and provisional amendment of the Law on the Control of Social and Health Care and amendment of section 6 of the Grey Economic Clearing House

fi-he-182-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on Transport Services
fi-he-182-2024.s: The project will prepare the necessary changes to the transport information regulatory package resulting from EU regulations, including regulation of the information obligations of the AFIR Regulation, the efTI Regulation and the MMTIS Regulation.
fi-he-182-2024.t: Act amending the Transport Services Act

fi-he-182-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the law on police and related laws
fi-he-182-2025.s: The project is designed to assess the need for changes to the provisions of Chapters 4 and 7 of the Police Act and Chapters 3 and 4 of the Police Personal Data Act in relation to the general legislation in force and to the requirements of the current police environment, and to prepare, on the basis of this assessment, proposals for the necessary legislative changes.
fi-he-182-2025.t: Act amending the law on police and related laws

fi-he-182-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for child protection law and related laws
fi-he-182-2026.s: The reform of the legislation on child protection will be carried out in accordance with the programme of Prime Minister Petteri Orpo's government, the second phase of the reform of the legislation on child protection.
fi-he-182-2026.t: Child protection law and related laws

fi-he-183-2020.s: The directive contains minimum provisions on the offences and penalties to be imposed in the form of money laundering, which are largely based on existing international obligations, but which go some further.
fi-he-183-2020.t: EU Directive on combating money laundering through criminal law

fi-he-183-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for the adoption and entry into force of the Framework Agreement on Comprehensive Partnership and Cooperation between the European Union and its Member States, of the one part, and the Kingdom of Thailand, of the other part
fi-he-183-2024.s: Adoption and implementation of the Framework Agreement on Partnership and Cooperation between the European Union and its Member States, of the one part, and Thailand, of the other part, in Finland.
fi-he-183-2024.t: for the adoption and entry into force of the Framework Agreement on Comprehensive Partnership and Cooperation between the European Union and its Member States, of the one part, and the Kingdom of Thailand, of the other part

fi-he-183-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Law on the Grey Economic Clearing House and to make certain related laws
fi-he-183-2025.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending the Law on the Economic Clearing House of the Grey; Act amending section 19 of the Law on the Publicity and Confidentiality of Tax Information; Act amending section 255 of the Code on Accidents at Work and Occupational Diseases; Act amending section 205 of the Workers' Pensions Act
fi-he-183-2025.t: Act amending the Law on the Economic Clearing House and into a number of related laws

fi-he-183-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the Investigation of the Cause of Death and the Law on the Medical Use of Human Bodies, Tissue and Cells
fi-he-183-2026.s: The project would provide for legal provisions on the detection of death and the conditions under which a medical practitioner or paramedic may find death, and the handling and preservation of the body would be clarified and other amendments would be made to the law on the cause of death.
fi-he-183-2026.t: amending the Act on the Exploration of the Cause of Death and the Law on the Medical Use of Human Bodies, Tissue and Cell

fi-he-184-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 3 of the Law on the State Television and Radio Fund
fi-he-184-2024.s: The project proposes to amend the Law on the State Television and Radio Fund in such a way that the State budget does not provide for annual increases according to the index in 2025, 2026 and 2027 to cover the public service costs of the State Television and Radio Fund.
fi-he-184-2024.t: Act amending section 3 of the State Broadcasting and Radio Fund Act

fi-he-184-2025.f: Draft legislation by the Government to the Parliament of Finland on the implementation of the European Union IPO
fi-he-184-2025.s: The project will prepare a government proposal to the Parliament of Finland, which will make the necessary amendments to national legislation following the implementation of the EU Listing Act of 23 October 2024 and will address any other changes to national legislation previously submitted for evaluation in the context of the proposal.
fi-he-184-2025.t: into legislation for the implementation of the European Union IPO

fi-he-184-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending the Act on the organisation of social and health care and sections 54 and 57 of the Health Act
fi-he-184-2026.s: The project will implement multi-production government programme records in two stages, and this second phase will assess and reduce the regulatory framework for adequate welfare area self-production where necessary, including some legislative changes related to the mandatory use of vouchers.
fi-he-184-2026.t: Act amending sections 54 and 57 of the Act on the organisation of social and health care

fi-he-185-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Regional Control Act and related laws
fi-he-185-2024.s: Finnish membership of NATO creates a need to examine the need for changes to the Regional Control Act. Prime Minister Orpo's government programme has stated that the government will assess the legislative change needs related to NATO membership and will immediately initiate the necessary preparations for them.
fi-he-185-2024.t: Act amending the Law on Regional Control and related laws

fi-he-185-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Law on precious metal products
fi-he-185-2025.s: Amendments are proposed to the Law on Precious Metal Products, including definitions, requirements for precious metal products and the rights of the Authority, as well as additions to the Convention on the inspection and stamping of precious metal products.
fi-he-185-2025.t: Act amending the Act on precious metal products

fi-he-185-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 12a of the Act on social and health care charges and on the Cause of Death
fi-he-185-2026.s: The project proposes to provide for certain new charges for healthcare clients and increases for some healthcare customers.
fi-he-185-2026.t: amending section 12a of the Act on social and health care charges and on the Cause of Death

fi-he-186-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on acceptance of certain changes in the border line between Finland and Norway in 2025
fi-he-186-2025.s: The proposal proposes that the Parliament of Finland give its consent to the adoption of the changes to the border line established in 2025 between Finland and Norway.
fi-he-186-2025.t: on the acceptance of certain changes in the border line identified in 2025 between Finland and Norway

fi-he-186-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland amending the Act on the Temporary Amendment of the Health Insurance Act and the Act on the Temporary Amendment of section 7b of the Act on Social Assistance
fi-he-186-2026.s: Development of a selection test for private medical care for insured persons aged 65 or over; it is proposed to add a physical therapist's visit; increase the annual visit limit for general medical practice to six visits; and extend the trial until 31.12.2028.
fi-he-186-2026.t: amending the Act on the Temporary Amendment of the Health Insurance Act and the Act on the Temporary Amendment of section 7b of the Act on Social Assistance

fi-he-187-2024.f: Proposal of the Government to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending section 22a of the Act on the Control of Social and Health Care and the Social Welfare Act
fi-he-187-2024.s: The proposal proposes to introduce a law amending section 22a of the Social Protection Act (741/2023) and the Social Welfare Act (1301/2014), which relates to the State's Draft Supplementary Budget for 2025 and is intended for consideration in the context of it.
fi-he-187-2024.t: amending section 22a of the Act on the Control of Social and Health Care and the Social Welfare Act

fi-he-187-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on legislation to extend the scope of the plea negotiations
fi-he-187-2025.s: The task of the working group is to assess the extension of the scope of the prosecution negotiations in order to speed up and streamline the criminal process.
fi-he-187-2025.t: Legislative instrument on extending the scope of the trial

fi-he-187-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the Financing of Unemployment Benefits
fi-he-187-2026.s: The proposal would set unemployment insurance contributions for 2027.
fi-he-187-2026.t: Act amending the Act on the financing of unemployment benefits

fi-he-188-2024.f: Presentation by the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland of the Law on the Centre for Housing Building and Related Laws of the State Support
fi-he-188-2024.s: The new law would provide for the establishment, tasks and decision-making powers of the State-supported housing centre.
fi-he-188-2024.t: Act on the Centre for Housing Building supported by the State and related laws

fi-he-188-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending the Act on Pre-litigation, the Law on Criminal Matters and section 3b of Chapter 11 of the legal order
fi-he-188-2025.s: OM / KRO / RPY The project would cover measures other than the negotiation of charges and the reform of the fine procedure. The preparation of the extension of the scope of the prosecution procedure will be carried out by the Working Party set up in autumn 2023 and the preparation of the overall assessment of the fine procedure by the Working Group set up in autumn 2024.
fi-he-188-2025.t: amending the Act on Pre-litigation, the Act on Criminal Matters and the Section 3b of Chapter 11 of the legal order

fi-he-188-2026.f: Proposal of the Government to the Parliament of Finland for the adoption and entry into force of an extended partial agreement on the Management Committee of the Special Court for the Attack of Ukraine
fi-he-188-2026.s: The proposal proposes that the Parliament of Finland approve the extended Oskar Convention on the Management Committee of the Special Court for the Attack of Ukraine in Chișinău and the Act on the enforcement of the provisions of the Treaty in the field of law.
