The reform will be carried out in a way that links professional rights only to the necessary and proportionate conditions for customer and patient safety.
fi-he-274-2026.t: amending sections 15 and 20 of the Health Care Professionals Act, the Health Care Professionals Act and the Authorisation and Control Agency Act

fi-he-275-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on the implementation of certain United Nations sanctions

fi-he-276-2026.f: Government proposal for the adoption and entry into force of the family and spouse agreement between Finland and Australia
fi-he-276-2026.s: The government proposal for the agreement is due to be submitted in autumn 2026.
fi-he-276-2026.t: Adoption and entry into force of the family and spouse agreement between Finland and Australia

fi-he-277-2026.s: The project is designed to prepare the main provisions on police criminal investigations and thus to improve police access to information on internal security threats related to police tasks.
fi-he-277-2026.t: Legislative project on police criminal intelligence legislation and related legislation, Phase 2

fi-he-278-2026.s: The project is preparing the proposed amendments to the Civil Protection Code in the framework of the "Exploration of the Reform of the Rescue Act" project (SMDro 2019- 2078) and other studies, taking into account the entries of Prime Minister Petteri Orpo's government programme.
fi-he-278-2026.t: The second phase of the rescue law reform project

fi-he-279-2026.s: The project is designed to prepare the main provisions on criminal intelligence of the Border Guard, thereby improving the ability of the Border Guard to better inform the Border Guard about internal security threats associated with the tasks of the Border Guard.
fi-he-279-2026.t: Legislative project on border guard criminal intelligence legislation (Phase 2)

fi-he-28-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on extradition between Finland and other Member States of the European Union and the Act on extradition between Finland and other Nordic countries
fi-he-28-2025.s: The aim is to present a government proposal amending the Act on extradition between Finland and the other Member States of the European Union.
fi-he-28-2025.t: amending the Act on extradition between Finland and other Member States of the European Union and the Act on extradition between Finland and other Nordic countries

fi-he-28-2026.f: Draft act of the Government to the Parliament of Finland amending the title of Chapter 9 and section 61 of the Customs Act
fi-he-28-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending the title of Chapter 9 and section 61 of the Customs Code
fi-he-28-2026.t: Act amending the title of Chapter 9 and section 61 of the Customs Code

fi-he-280-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Fisheries Act
fi-he-280-2026.s: The proposal introduces a new section 7a in the Fisheries Act, which provides that general fishing rights within the meaning of section 7 of the Act should not be used for commercial fishing, and proposes that the law be amended to remove the exception allowing the sale of a small quantity of fish or crab to leisure fishermen.

fi-he-281-2026.s: The project aims to implement the amendments made in 2024 by Directive (EU) 2024/3101 of the EU Directive on ship emissions, while proposing certain amendments to the Annex to the International Convention on the Prevention of Pollution from Ships (MARPOL).
fi-he-281-2026.t: Amendments to the Marine Environmental Protection Act; implementation of the Ship Emissions Directive

fi-he-282-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the Central Data Register
fi-he-282-2026.s: The government's proposal proposes to introduce a requirement for data centres to register to maintain the industry's situation picture, which would provide authorities with a more comprehensive and forward-looking picture of the investment in the data centre.

fi-he-283-2026.s: Opinions were requested on the draft opinion from 9 March to 4 May 2026.

fi-he-284-2026.f: Government proposal on information reserves under the Environmental Protection Act, the Law on the Organisation of Water Management and the Law on the Management of the Sea and the Nature Conservation Act
fi-he-284-2026.s: The project examines the need for changes to the provisions of the Information System for the protection of the environment and nature protection in relation to the overall reform of the government's programme-based data protection legislation.
fi-he-284-2026.t: on information reserves under the Environmental Protection Act, the Water Management Act and the Nature Conservation Act

fi-he-285-2026.f: Government proposal for national implementation of the Urban Waste Water Directive
fi-he-285-2026.s: Preparation of amendments to national legislation required by the recast Urban Waste Water Treatment Directive; environmental protection law, water management law, health protection law, infectious disease law, and possibly civil engineering law, circular economy law and energy efficiency law.
fi-he-285-2026.t: National implementation of the Urban Waste Water Directive

fi-he-286-2026.s: The project will make a proposal to introduce a provision on the revision of permit regulations into the Environmental Protection Act (527/2014).
fi-he-286-2026.t: Restoration of the procedure for the revision of the permit provisions of the Environmental Protection Act

fi-he-287-2026.f: Government proposal to implement the amendment of the Air Quality Directive
fi-he-287-2026.s: Implementation of the amendment to Directive (EU) 2024/2881 of the European Parliament and of the Council on ambient air quality and improvement of air quality (2008 / 50 / EC) by amending the Environmental Protection Act and the Air Quality Regulation. The deadline for national implementation expires on 10 December 2026.
fi-he-287-2026.t: on the implementation of the amendment of the Air Quality Directive

fi-he-288-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 4 of the Act on the restriction of the use of hazardous substances in electrical and electronic equipment
fi-he-288-2026.s: The proposal proposes to amend section 4 of the RoHS Act (387/2013) in order to implement the OSOA Directive (EU 2025/2456) and to move to the reference procedure in order to ensure that certain technical annexes and amendments to the RoHS Directive (EU 2011 / 65) enter into force directly without national action.
fi-he-288-2026.t: amending section 4 of the Act on the restriction of the use of hazardous substances in electrical and electronic equipment

fi-he-29-2023.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the temporary travel document of the European Union and related laws
fi-he-29-2023.s: The Government's proposal brings into force at national level Council Directive (EU) 2019 / 997, the Directive lays down the conditions and procedural rules under which non-represented citizens can obtain an EU temporary travel document (EU TMA).
fi-he-29-2023.t: Law on the European Union's temporary travel document and related laws

fi-he-29-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Foreign Law
fi-he-29-2024.s: The project prepares a government proposal for the implementation of certain amendments to the Alien Law that the EU Directive on Definitions (2011 / 95 / EU) allows and complements the national implementation of the Directive.

fi-he-29-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending Chapter 5a of the Police Act and for certain other laws
fi-he-29-2025.s: The project is essentially concerned with the revision of civil intelligence law and the law on the exchange of information between the police department of protection
fi-he-29-2025.t: Law on the modification of Chapter 5a of the Police Act and on certain other laws

fi-he-29-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation on the taxation of real estate and income from offshore wind
fi-he-29-2026.s: The project prepares legislative changes to ensure property and income taxation in the Finnish Economic Zone.
fi-he-29-2026.t: Legislation on property and income taxation for offshore wind power

fi-he-299-2022.f: Government bill for social and health care supervision
fi-he-299-2022.s: The proposed new law would bring together provisions on operating conditions for social and health services, ex ante controls, registration, self-control and means of ex post supervision, covering both public service providers and providers and private service providers.
fi-he-299-2022.t: As a law on social and health care supervision

fi-he-3-2025.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the amendment of the Vehicle Act and related laws
fi-he-3-2025.s: The legislative project would amend the vehicle law and the criminal record law in order to comply with the requirements of the EU vehicle regulation and to allow independent vehicle maintenance and repair operators to obtain a criminal record for the purposes of the so-called SERMI certification.
fi-he-3-2025.t: Act amending the vehicle law and related laws

fi-he-3-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the Safety of the Handling of Dangerous Chemicals and Explosives and the Construction Act
fi-he-3-2026.s: The project aims to introduce provisions on plants of major importance for defence into the Law on the Safety of the Handling of Dangerous Chemicals and Explosives (Chemical Safety Act) and the Construction Act.
fi-he-3-2026.t: amending the Act on the Safety of the Handling of Dangerous Chemicals and Explosives and the Construction Act

fi-he-30-2023.f: Presentation by the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland of Law on the Legal Service Agency and related laws
fi-he-30-2023.s: The project prepares a government bill for the Legal Service Agency, which is responsible for organising legal assistance, financial and debt advice and public interest control services.
fi-he-30-2023.t: Law on the Justice Service Agency and related laws

fi-he-30-2025.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland amending section 50o of the Act on Trade in Financial Instruments, the Investment Services Act and the Financial Supervision Act
fi-he-30-2025.s: The project aims at national implementation of the amendments to MiFID II by the deadline, which prepares the government's proposal for the amendment of the Investment Services Act and the Trade Finance Instruments Act.
fi-he-30-2025.t: amending section 50o of the Act on Trade in Financial Instruments, the Investment Services Act and the Financial Supervision Act

fi-he-30-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending the Forest Act, the Nature Conservation Act and the Finnish Forest Information System Act
fi-he-30-2026.s: The project is prepared by a government proposal to amend the Forest Act to lay down the obligations and limitations of forest logging and other forest management at the time of the breeding of birds, with the aim of including the necessary proposals for amendment of section 70 of the Nature Conservation Act.
fi-he-30-2026.t: amending the Forest Act, the Nature Conservation Act and the Finnish Forest Information System Act

fi-he-300-2022.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation on patient and social affairs
fi-he-300-2022.s: The Government's proposal proposes to introduce a new law on patients and social affairs, which would provide for the organisation of the activities of patients' and social affairs, the independence, eligibility and tasks of the patient and social affairs officer, and the processing of personal data.
fi-he-300-2022.t: As a law for patients and social partners

fi-he-305-2022.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the organisation of social and health care and section 60 of the Health Act and repealing sections 28 and 29 of the Special Health Care Act (functions of the university hospital)
fi-he-305-2022.s: It is proposed to add provisions to the Social and Health Care Act to clarify and strengthen the existing functions and responsibilities of the university hospital in specialised medical services and in the areas of education, research, development and innovation.
fi-he-305-2022.t: As a law amending section 60 of the Act on the Organisation of Social and Health Care and repealing sections 28 and 29 of the Special Health Care Act (functions of a university hospital)

fi-he-31-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation on administrative reform of the Office of the Ministry of Education and Culture
fi-he-31-2025.s: The proposal proposes to introduce a new law on administrative agencies of the Ministry of Education and Culture, the Law on the Board of Education, the Law on National Archives, the Law on Cultural Heritage and the Law on the Finnish Academy of Culture, and to amend the Act on the Academy of Finland. It also proposes to introduce a law on the library services of readers.
fi-he-31-2025.t: Legislation on the reform of the Office of the Ministry of Education and Culture

fi-he-31-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 14 of the Act on organic production
fi-he-31-2026.s: The proposal is to amend the Act on organic production, and the section on authorised inspectors is proposed to amend the mandate of authorised inspectors to the Food Agency or the Life Force Centre, where the current law only allows them to do so by the Agency.
fi-he-31-2026.t: Amendment of section 14 of the Organic Production Act

fi-he-316-2022.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Law on Medical Research and to amend certain related laws
fi-he-316-2022.s: It proposes to amend the Law on Medical Research to meet the requirements arising from the reform of the organisation of social and health care, and to amend the Research Act and some related laws on the collection of opinions fees by Regional Ethics Councils.
fi-he-316-2022.t: Act amending the Law on Medical Research and certain other related laws

fi-he-32-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the VAT Act
fi-he-32-2024.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending the VAT Act

fi-he-32-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to supplement the European Media Freedom Act
fi-he-32-2025.s: The Ministry of Transport and Communications is preparing a proposal for a common framework for media services in the internal market of Regulation (EU) 2024/1083 of the European Parliament and of the Council and for amending Directive 2010 / 13 / EU (European Media Freedom Act) into national law on implementation.
fi-he-32-2025.t: From a European Media Freedom Act to a complementary legislation

fi-he-32-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 17 of the Animal Welfare Act and the Animal Medication Act
fi-he-32-2026.s: The aim of the proposal is to repeal the prohibition of surgical castration on the animal welfare law and to amend the Animal Medication Act in order to allow the veterinarian to release the injectable anesthetic for the surgical castration of piglets also to holdings not linked to the national animal health programme.
fi-he-32-2026.t: amending section 17 of the Animal Welfare Act and the Animal Medication Act

fi-he-33-2023.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to change the Parenthood Act and related laws
fi-he-33-2023.s: Complement the legislation on parental responsibility by regulating the identification and confirmation of the mother who gave birth, including the Law on Legal Genetic Paternity Studies (378/2005), and allow for tissue sampling of the deceased buried for legal genetic parenting studies.
fi-he-33-2023.t: Act amending the Parenthood Act and related laws

fi-he-33-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on Transport Services
fi-he-33-2025.s: The project is based on the objective of developing publicly organised transport services in the government programme of Prime Minister Petteri Orpo, with the aim of maximising the added value of the resources allocated to the organisation of these services.
fi-he-33-2025.t: Act amending the Act on Transport Services

fi-he-33-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland amending the Act on the Rental of the Apartment and the Act on the Rental of the Business Apartment
fi-he-33-2026.s: The Act on the rental of residential dwellings (481/1995) has been in force for more than 30 years and has mainly been subject to minor technical changes. However, the operating environment for the rental of residential apartments has changed significantly since the adoption of the law, making it necessary to assess the functioning of the law and the needs for change.
fi-he-33-2026.t: Act amending the Act on the rental of dwellings and the Act on the rental of commercial dwellings

fi-he-34-2025.f: Board of Directors' proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Act on Uhradio Oy
fi-he-34-2025.s: The aim of the project is to make amendments to the General Law proposed by the Parliamentary General Working Party, and to add the criteria and procedures for the selection and dismissal of senior executives as required by the EU Media Freedom Regulation, as set out by the Parliamentary General Working Party.
fi-he-34-2025.t: Act amending the Law on Uhradio Oy

fi-he-34-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Housing Companies Act
fi-he-34-2026.s: Updating the Housing Companies Act. The government programme responds to the needs to ensure the conditions for short-term rental and to address the problems encountered, address and take-over the disruptions of housing companies, the management of housing companies in the downfall and the installation of electrical car charging facilities.
fi-he-34-2026.t: Act amending the Housing Companies Act

fi-he-35-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for adoption and implementation of amendments to the World Health Organisation's International Health Code (2005)
fi-he-35-2025.s: The proposal proposes that the Parliament of Finland adopt the amendments to the World Health Organisation's International Health Code (2005) by Resolution WHHA77.17 of the World Health Organisation General Assembly to the extent that they fall within the competence of Finland.
fi-he-35-2025.t: adopting and implementing amendments to the World Health Organisation's International Health Code (2005)

fi-he-35-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Basic Education Act
fi-he-35-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending the Basic Education Act
fi-he-35-2026.t: The law on the amendment of the Basic Education Act

fi-he-36-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for the adoption and implementation of amendments to the Convention on Road Transport
fi-he-36-2024.s: The aim of the legislative project is to prepare a proposal from the Government proposing that the Parliament of Finland adopt the amendments to the Convention on Road Transport adopted at the 86th session of the UN / ECE Working Party on Road Safety, which the Secretary-General of the UN circulated to all Contracting Parties on 9 September 2023.
fi-he-36-2024.t: Adoption and entry into force of amendments to the Road Transport Convention

fi-he-36-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 7b of the Health Insurance Act and the Act on Social Insurance
fi-he-36-2025.s: The project aims at establishing a choice of reimbursement of private medical care for people aged 65 or over and to prepare legislation for it.
fi-he-36-2025.t: Act amending section 7b of the Health Insurance Act and the Act on Social Insurance

fi-he-36-2026.f: Draft laws of the Government amending section 6 and section 2 of Chapter 1 of the Food Market Act and Chapter 5 of the Law on the Legal Procedure in Market Law
fi-he-36-2026.s: Preparation of the Government's proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Food Market Act (second phase), which forms part of the measures taken under point 6.6 of Prime Minister Orpo's government programme to implement proposals that will lead to fairer status of primary producer and balance of the entire food chain.
fi-he-36-2026.t: Act amending Chapter 1, Section 6 and Chapter 5, Section 2 of the Food Market Act and the Law on the Legal Procedure in Market Law

fi-he-37-2024.f: Draft legislation by the Board of Directors to change the laws relating to the reorganisation of employment services
fi-he-37-2024.s: To make the necessary additions and technical changes to the laws relating to the reorganization of employment services (TE services 2024 reform) necessary for the smooth transfer of responsibility for organisation and to increase the discretion of the expert in the service process of the jobseeker as regards the organisation of job search discussions.
fi-he-37-2024.t: Legislative changes to the laws relating to the reorganisation of employment services

fi-he-37-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation amending the Act on Biofuels, Bioliquids and Biofuels and repealing section 7 (7) of the Act on the Promotion of the Use of Renewable Fuels in Transport
fi-he-37-2025.s: The proposal proposes to amend the Act on Biofuels, Bioliquids and Biofuels (so-called "Sustainability Act"), which is based on the implementation of the updated Renewable Energy Directive (RED III, (EU) 2023/2413).
fi-he-37-2025.t: Act amending the Act on Biofuels, Bioliquids and Biofuels and repealing section 7 (7) of the Act on the Promotion of the Use of Renewable Fuels in Transport

fi-he-37-2026.f: Draft act of the Government to the Parliament of Finland amending sections 1a and 4a of the Act implementing the Regulation on the European Union's carbon limit mechanism
fi-he-37-2026.s: The proposal proposes to amend the rules on penalties for the implementation of the European Union's carbon border mechanism regulation as required by EU law.
fi-he-37-2026.t: Act amending sections 1a and 4a of the Act implementing the Regulation on the European Union's carbon limit mechanism

fi-he-38-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Tobacco Act
fi-he-38-2024.s: The purpose of the tobacco law is to provide for sales, characteristics, packaging, etc.

fi-he-38-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend and temporarily amend the Act on the Financing of Welfare Areas
fi-he-38-2025.s: The proposal implements the changes in the base ratio in accordance with the government programme, as well as the one-off savings on transitional adjustments as set out in the budgetary plan, and some updates of the financial determinants which are due to enter into force in 2026.
fi-he-38-2025.t: Act amending and temporarily amending the Act on the financing of Welfare Areas

fi-he-38-2026.f: Draft laws of the Government to the Parliament of Finland amending section 1 and section 5a of Chapter 3 of Chapter 1 of the Accounting and Audit Act
fi-he-38-2026.s: The proposal introduces a law amending the Accounting Act and a law amending Chapter 3 of the Audit Act, which would reduce the scope of the sustainability reporting obligations and reduce reporting requirements, and implement the provisions of the so-called sustainability reporting amendment Directive.
fi-he-38-2026.t: Act amending Section 1 and Section 5a of Chapter 3 of Chapter 1 of the Accounting Act and the Audit Act

fi-he-39-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 5b of the Tax Recovery Act and the Tax Increase and Late Interest Act
fi-he-39-2025.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending the Tax Recovery Act; Act amending section 5b of the Tax Increase and Late Interest Act
fi-he-39-2025.t: Act amending section 5b of the Tax Recovery Act and the Law on Tax Addition and Delay Interest

fi-he-39-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on equality between women and men
fi-he-39-2026.s: In order to prevent pregnancy and family leave discrimination, amendments to the Equal Opportunities Act are being prepared.
fi-he-39-2026.t: Amendment of the Law on Equality between Women and Men

fi-he-4-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Law on the National Board of Antiquities
fi-he-4-2025.s: A provision is added to the Law on the Office to act as the competent authority for issuing import licences under the EU Regulation on the movement and import of cultural goods into the customs territory of the Member States.
fi-he-4-2025.t: Act amending the Law of the National Board of Antiquities

fi-he-4-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for laws amending the Waste Act and certain related laws
fi-he-4-2026.s: The third phase of the implementation of the EU battery regulation will complete all the remaining regulatory changes needed (in particular the provisions on producer responsibility), and the necessary amendments to the SER Directive and the EU Waste Shipment Regulation will be implemented.
fi-he-4-2026.t: amending the Waste Act and certain related laws

fi-he-40-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the amendment of the Water Management Act
fi-he-40-2025.s: Working group set up by the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry to prepare the reform of the Water Management Act (119/2001).
fi-he-40-2025.t: Law on the amendment of the Water Maintenance Act

fi-he-40-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend legislation on the occupational pension scheme
fi-he-40-2026.s: The task of the working group is to prepare changes to the legislation on occupational pensions in line with the outcome of the negotiations reached by the social partners on 19 January 2025, in the form of a proposal from the Board of Directors.
fi-he-40-2026.t: amending the legislation on the occupational pension scheme

fi-he-41-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the treatment of certain environmental matters by the Authorisation and Control Office and for a number of related laws
fi-he-41-2025.s: The project will develop regulation of environmental authorisation procedures and promote key government programme entries for the implementation of the so-called one-stop model, with the aim of streamlining the authorisation procedures for projects with environmental impact in the model of one national authorisation, guidance and supervisory authority.
fi-he-41-2025.t: Act on the treatment of certain environmental matters by the Agency for Authorisation and Control and on certain related laws

fi-he-41-2026.f: Presentation by the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland for the reform of product sector legislation
fi-he-41-2026.s: Implementation of the acts accompanying the Internal Market Emergency and Resilience Act, which aim to ensure the normal functioning of the internal market, including the free movement of goods, services and persons, and to ensure the availability of goods and services of critical importance to citizens, businesses and public authorities.

fi-he-42-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the Authorisation of Renewable Energy Plant and certain other Administrative Procedures, sections 3 and 5 of the Environmental Impact Assessment Act and section 35 of the Nature Conservation Act
fi-he-42-2025.s: The Act on the Authorisation of Renewable Energy Plants and certain other Administrative Procedures would be amended as required by the amendment of the Renewable Energy Directive (RED III).
fi-he-42-2025.t: amending the Act on the Authorisation and certain other administrative procedures for renewable energy production installations, sections 3 and 5 of the Act on the Environmental Impact Assessment and section 35 of the Nature Conservation Act

fi-he-42-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend sections 14 and 16 of the Security of Supply Act and section 7 of the VAT Act
fi-he-42-2026.s: Amendment of the Act on Security of Supply and Security of Supply (107/2026, the Safety of Supply Act) and the VAT Act (1501/1993), with the aim of updating section 7 of the VAT Act so that the Maintenance Safety Fund would be subject to VAT instead of the Security of Supply Centre.
fi-he-42-2026.t: Act amending sections 14 and 16 of the Maintenance Security Act and section 7 of the VAT Act

fi-he-43-2025.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland as a law amending section 13 of the Law on a positive credit register and the Act on an apartment information system and repealing section 22 (2) (12) of the Law on a positive credit information register
fi-he-43-2025.s: The project will prepare legislative amendments to allow the data content of the positive credit register to cover the shareholder-specific debt shares of housing companies' loans, and the related information may be further disclosed to creditors and credit market supervisors.
fi-he-43-2025.t: Amendment of section 13 of the Law on a positive credit register and the Act on an apartment information system and repealing section 22 (2) (12) of the Law on a positive credit information register

fi-he-43-2026.f: The Board's proposal to the Parliament of Finland to change the Insurance Companies Act and to become separate related laws
fi-he-43-2026.s: The project prepares a proposal from the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Insurance Companies Act and other related laws to implement the amendments to the Solvency II Directive at national level.
fi-he-43-2026.t: Act amending the Insurance Companies Act and related laws

fi-he-44-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend sections 46 and 55 of the Income Tax Act
fi-he-44-2025.s: Increase the amount of forest reduction from 60% to 75% of the purchase price of the forest.
fi-he-44-2025.t: Act amending sections 46 and 55 of the Income Tax Act

fi-he-44-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the amendment of the Alcohol Act
fi-he-44-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending the Alcohol Act
fi-he-44-2026.t: Law on the amendment of the Alcohol Act

fi-he-45-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend sections 12 and 96 of the Electricity Market Act and the Natural Gas Market Act
fi-he-45-2025.s: The electricity market law would be reformed to integrate the increasing load of electricity generation and consumption into the grid and the high voltage distribution system.
fi-he-45-2025.t: As a law amending sections 12 and 96 of the Electricity Market Act and the Gas Market Act

fi-he-45-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation on the implementation of directives on equality and equality bodies
fi-he-45-2026.s: The project will prepare a proposal from the Government to amend the laws of the Parliament of Finland on the equal opportunities and equal opportunities mandate and, where appropriate, other related laws for the national implementation of the Directives on equality and equality bodies.
fi-he-45-2026.t: Legislation on the implementation of the Directives on equality and equality bodies

fi-he-46-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation supplementing the EU artificial intelligence regulation
fi-he-46-2025.s: The Government's proposal lays down national obligations under the Regulation on artificial intelligence of the European Parliament and of the Council by law on the supervision of certain systems of artificial intelligence and amends the Law on market surveillance of certain products, the Financial Supervision Act, the Energy Agency Act and the Law on the Enforcement of the fine.
fi-he-46-2025.t: Complementary legislation to the EU artificial intelligence regulation

fi-he-46-2026.f: Government proposal to amend the provisions of the law on data protection and the processing of personal data in criminal matters and in the context of the maintenance of national security
fi-he-46-2026.s: The project concerns the evaluation of the penalties applicable to breaches of data protection legislation, which provides a memorandum of assessment in preparation for the necessary legislative changes.
fi-he-46-2026.t: amending the provisions of the law on data protection and the processing of personal data in criminal matters and in the context of the maintenance of national security

fi-he-47-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending Chapter 11 of the Criminal Code
fi-he-47-2025.s: Revise the criminalisation of the Holocaust and other crimes against humanity by introducing a separate provision in the criminal code.
fi-he-47-2025.t: Act amending Chapter 11 of the Criminal Code

fi-he-47-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Consumer Protection Act, the Waste Act and the Law on Certain Powers of Consumer Protection Authorities
fi-he-47-2026.s: The laws necessary for the implementation of the Green Transition Consumer Protection Directive and the Goods Repair Directive were adopted on 26 June 2026. The regulation on environmental claims and sustainability labelling is also contained in the Government Regulation of 2 July 2026 (see project OM032: 00/2026).
fi-he-47-2026.t: Act amending the Consumer Protection Act, the Waste Act and the Act on certain powers of consumer protection authorities

fi-he-48-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on International Cooperation in the Enforcement of Certain Criminal Sanctions
fi-he-48-2025.s: The project will assess whether legislation should be amended to allow the death penalty sentenced in another country to be converted into the next penalty for freedom for the act in question in Finland.
fi-he-48-2025.t: amending the Act on International Cooperative Action in the Enforcement of Certain Criminal Sanctions

fi-he-48-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the Identification and Registration of Animals
fi-he-48-2026.s: The project is designed to prepare a draft law amending the Act on the Identification and Registration of Animals (1069/2021), which clarifies and amends the Act on the Identification and Registration of Animals as regards the needs for clarification identified in the practical application of the law.
fi-he-48-2026.t: Act amending the Act on the Identification and Registration of Animals

fi-he-49-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending the Act on the European Maritime, Fisheries and Aquaculture Fund
fi-he-49-2025.s: Technical changes allowing for the introduction of financial instruments
fi-he-49-2025.t: Act amending the Act on the European Maritime, Fisheries and Aquaculture Fund

fi-he-49-2026.f: Presentation by the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland of amendments to the legislation on the exchange of information between the Social Insurance Institution of Finland
fi-he-49-2026.s: Under Prime Minister Petteri Orpo's government programme, social security abuses are prevented and the exchange of information between Kela and other authorities is promoted as well as Kela's rights to information.
fi-he-49-2026.t: amending the legislation on the exchange of information between public pension institutions

fi-he-5-2025.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the law implementing the fine and for a number of related laws
fi-he-5-2025.s: The project is preparing a reform of the law on the enforcement of the fine.
fi-he-5-2025.t: Act amending the Law on the Enforcement of the fine and into a number of related laws

fi-he-5-2026.f: Draft law of the Board of Directors amending the Act on the imposition of fines and fine and related laws
fi-he-5-2026.s: The project explains the scope of the fine and fine law (754/2010), as well as other needs for amendment of the law.
fi-he-5-2026.t: Act amending the Law on the imposition of fines and fine payments and related laws

fi-he-50-2023.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 1 of the Act on Electronic Communications Services and the Act on the Enforcement of the fine
fi-he-50-2023.s: The Government's proposal proposes that the authorities in accordance with Chapters 3 and 4 of the EU Data Management Regulation should be entrusted to the Transport and Communications Agency and that the Agency should propose ways of monitoring the Regulation and imposing sanctions.
fi-he-50-2023.t: Act amending section 1 of the Law on the Enforcement of the Law on Electronic Communications Services and the Penal Code

fi-he-50-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the organisation of social care and health care and related laws
fi-he-50-2025.s: The government is implementing a voluntary return and exit package, which includes, among other things, the abolition of the right of illegal residents to non-urgent social and health services and social security, in other words, the return to the legal situation prior to the last parliamentary term.
fi-he-50-2025.t: Act amending the Act on the organisation of social care and health care and related laws

fi-he-50-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 10 of the Finnish Constitution
fi-he-50-2026.s: Preparation of the necessary amendments to section 10 of the Constitution, taking into account the needs of criminal, civil and military intelligence and EU law, new forms of serious crime and technological development.
fi-he-50-2026.t: Act amending section 10 of the Finnish Constitution

fi-he-51-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the University Act and the Polytechnic Act
fi-he-51-2024.s: The Ministry of Education and Culture has set up a project to increase tuition fees and to prevent evasion of tuition fees by amending the University Act and the Polytechnic Act.
fi-he-51-2024.t: Act amending the University Act and the Polytechnic Act

fi-he-51-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the amendment of the marriage law and related laws
fi-he-51-2025.s: Let us make provision for the limitation of the marriage right when the marriage has ended in divorce or has been annulled by judgment.
fi-he-51-2025.t: Law on the amendment of the marriage law and related laws

fi-he-51-2026.f: Proposal of the Government to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending section 7b of the Foreign Law and the Penal Code
fi-he-51-2026.s: The project aims to explore and develop a comprehensive set of rules on depopulation.
fi-he-51-2026.t: Act amending section 7b of Chapter 17 of the Foreign Law and the Criminal Code

fi-he-52-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on Finland's participation in the European Union Agency for Criminal Justice Cooperation (Eurojust)
fi-he-52-2025.s: The aim is to draft amendments to the Act on Finland's participation in the European Union Agency for Criminal Cooperation (Eurojust) (1232/2019) as required by the EU Council Regulation and Directive 2023/2131, which will enhance the digital exchange of information on terrorist offences in Eurojust.
fi-he-52-2025.t: Act amending the Act on Finland's participation in the European Union Agency for Criminal Justice Cooperation (Eurojust)

fi-he-52-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for the implementation of the acts forming the EU Pact on Migration and Asylum
fi-he-52-2026.s: The project will prepare legislative changes necessary for the national implementation of the new EU Pact on Migration and Asylum ("the pact").
fi-he-52-2026.t: implementing the acts forming the EU Pact on Migration and Asylum

fi-he-53-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending section 9 of the Act on Prisoners, the Act on Investigation and the Code of Defence
fi-he-53-2025.s: The project will assess the need for changes to the Penitentiary Act and the Act on Extradition and prepare the necessary amendments to the rules.
fi-he-53-2025.t: amending section 9 of the Act on Prisoners, the Act on Investigation and the Code of Defence

fi-he-53-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on automatic data retrieval and exchange of information in European police cooperation and on the processing of personal data by police
fi-he-53-2026.s: The project will prepare a proposal for amendments to national legislation required by the EU Regulation on the automatic search and exchange of information in police cooperation and amending certain Council decisions and regulations (Prüm II Regulation).
fi-he-53-2026.t: amending the Act on the automatic retrieval and exchange of information in European police cooperation and on the processing of personal data by police

fi-he-54-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the service voucher for early childhood education and for a number of related laws
fi-he-54-2025.s: According to Prime Minister Orpo's government programme, the legislation on vouchers for early childhood education will be transferred to the Ministry of Education and Culture, as was the aim of the reform of the ECEC.
fi-he-54-2025.t: Law on the Service Case for Early Education and a number of related laws

fi-he-54-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Act on Citizenship and related laws
fi-he-54-2026.s: The Ministry of the Interior has set up the project for the third phase of preparation of the amendments to the Citizenship Act (359/2003).
fi-he-54-2026.t: Act amending the Act on Citizenship and related laws

fi-he-55-2023.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending section 51a of the Act amending the Health Care Act and section 10a of the Act amending the Law on the Health Care of Higher Education Students
fi-he-55-2023.s: The proposal proposes that the maximum period of seven days for access to basic health care should be abolished and that the maximum duration of access to treatment should be set by the legislation in force for an indefinite period of 14 days, in line with the temporary legislation in force at 1.9.2023.
fi-he-55-2023.t: Amendment of section 51a of the Health Act and of section 10a of the Law amending the Law on the Education of Higher Education Students

fi-he-55-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the ECEC
fi-he-55-2025.s: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the ECEC

fi-he-55-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Law on the Defence Forces
fi-he-55-2026.s: The age of resignation of the military posts would be changed to reflect the delay in retirement provided for by the Public Sector Pensions Act, which is a consequence of the change in life expectancy.
fi-he-55-2026.t: Amendment of the Law on the Defence Forces

fi-he-56-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to terminate the Convention on the Prohibition of the Use, Stockpiling, Production and Transfer of Anti-personnel Mines and their Destruction and to include laws related thereto
fi-he-56-2025.s: Issue a government proposal for denunciation of the Convention on the Prohibition of the Use, Storage, Production and Transfer of Anti-personnel Mines and their Destruction (the Ottawa Convention) and related laws.
fi-he-56-2025.t: to denounce the Convention on the Prohibition of the Use, Storage, Production and Transfer of Anti-personnel Mines and their Destruction, and as related laws

fi-he-56-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the Financing of Welfare Areas and the Act on the Promotion of the Development of Archipelago
fi-he-56-2026.s: Changes to the needs and circumstances of the financing model in accordance with the government programme and to the transitional adjustments are implemented, and savings measures are to be made in line with the objectives of reducing the government's cost growth (Government Programme Annex B), which are to enter into force on 1 January 2027.
fi-he-56-2026.t: amending the Act on the Financing of Welfare Areas and the Act on the Promotion of the Evolution of Archipelago

fi-he-57-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation implementing the Cybersecurity Directive (NIS 2)
fi-he-57-2024.s: The aim of the project is to transpose the obligations of the NIS 2 Directive (EU) 2022/2555 into national law.
fi-he-57-2024.t: Legislation on the implementation of the Cybersecurity Directive (NIS 2)

fi-he-57-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to supplement the Regulation on transparency and targeting of EU political advertising
fi-he-57-2025.s: Regulation (EU) 2024 / 900 of the European Parliament and of the Council on the transparency and targeting of political advertising was adopted on 13 March 2024, which is directly applicable legislation, but still requires, before its final entry into force (10 October 2025), national rules on supervisory authorities and sanctions to be specified by the Member States.
fi-he-57-2025.t: The Regulation on the transparency and targeting of EU political advertising as complementary legislation

fi-he-57-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to change the Income Tax Act
fi-he-57-2026.s: The income tax law is amended to clarify the creation of the effective management position of foreign funds in Finland based on the management company's operations. The proposal is based on the semi-interim growth activities of Prime Minister Orpo's Board of Directors.
fi-he-57-2026.t: Act amending the Income Tax Act

fi-he-58-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on Government Support Services for Electronic Services
fi-he-58-2026.s: In accordance with the amendment to the decision to set up the digital programme on 28 April 2025 (VN / 36598/2023-VM-50), the programme will be extended to allow for the provision of public service service notifications to private digital postal services in addition to the joint administrative communication service. The Ministry of Finance is responsible for the legislative work required as an official work.
fi-he-58-2026.t: Act amending the Act on Public Service Support Services for Electronic Services

fi-he-59-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the supervision of the administration of bankruptcy estate
fi-he-59-2024.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending the law on the control of the administration of bankruptcy estate
fi-he-59-2024.t: Act amending the Act on the control of the administration of bankruptcy grounds

fi-he-59-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Income Tax Act temporarily
fi-he-59-2025.s: The proposal proposes that the Income Tax Act be amended in order to extend for one year the term of the temporary fund of funds applicable to the Communities' general tax liability on the basis of the actual place of management.
fi-he-59-2025.t: Law on the temporary amendment of the Income Tax Act

fi-he-59-2026.f: Draft laws of the Government to the Parliament of Finland amending sections 124 and 121b of the Income Tax Act and sections 12 and 12f of the Tax Accounts Act
fi-he-59-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending sections 124 and 124 b of the Income Tax Act; Act amending sections 12 and 12f of the Tax Accounting Act
fi-he-59-2026.t: As regards the laws amending sections 124 and 124 b of the Income Tax Act and sections 12 and 12f of the Tax Accounts Act

fi-he-6-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on the conditions of entry and residence of third-country nationals for highly skilled work and a number of related laws
fi-he-6-2024.s: The project aims to implement Directive (EU) 2021/1883 of the European Parliament and of the Council on the conditions of entry and residence of third-country nationals for the purpose of highly skilled work and repealing Council Directive 2009 / 50 / EC.
fi-he-6-2024.t: on the conditions of entry and residence of third-country nationals for highly skilled work and as a number of related laws

fi-he-6-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Law on the Defence Forces and related laws
fi-he-6-2025.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending the Defence Forces Act; Act amending sections 62 and 78 of the Code; Act amending sections 12 and 40 of the Military Vehicle Act; Act amending section 20 of the Law on Military Intelligence
fi-he-6-2025.t: Amendment of the Law on the Defence Forces and related laws

fi-he-6-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland to supplement the proposal of the Government amending the Law on Minimum Tax on Large Groups (HE 196/2025 vp)
fi-he-6-2026.s: Complementing the Law on Minimum Tax on Large Groups (1308/2023), the purpose of which is to supplement the provisions of the Minimum Tax Act to the extent that national legislation is required to implement the OECD Guidelines.
fi-he-6-2026.t: Law supplementing the Government's proposal amending the Law on Minimum Tax for Large Groups (HE 196/2025 vp)

fi-he-60-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for cooperation in Evangelis Lutheran Church and related laws
fi-he-60-2025.s: The church meeting of the Finnish Evangelis-Lutheran Church has proposed that the Government take steps to co-operate with the law of the Evangelis-Lutheran Church and related laws.
fi-he-60-2025.t: Law on co-operation in the Evangelis Lutheran Church and related laws

fi-he-60-2026.f: Draft law of the Government to the Parliament of Finland suspending the application of the law on the enforcement of the provisions of the Protocol amending the Agreement on double taxation of income taxes with Russia
fi-he-60-2026.s: In August 2023, Russia announced that it would suspend some of the provisions of the tax treaties with Finland and other EU countries in response to the economic sanctions imposed on it by the countries. Finland has applied the agreement for the time being.
fi-he-60-2026.t: suspending the application of the law transposing the provisions of the Protocol amending the Agreement on double taxation of income taxes with Russia

fi-he-61-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending Chapters 17 and 20 of the Criminal Code
fi-he-61-2025.s: The criminality of holding CAM material (Child Abuse Material) will be strengthened, the possession of violence is criminalised, and the possession of a picture of the child sexually imposed, and the possession of other brutal violent material will be criminalised to protect humans and animals.
fi-he-61-2025.t: Act amending Chapters 17 and 20 of the Criminal Code

fi-he-61-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 65b of the Electricity Market Act
fi-he-61-2026.s: Due to the delay in the adoption of the regulatory framework for market-based load management laid down in section 66b of the Electricity Market Act, the implementation schedule defined in the Electricity Market Act is moved forward in order to allow an adequate implementation time for the industry.
fi-he-61-2026.t: Act amending section 66b of the Electricity Market Act

fi-he-62-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 16 of the Act on the enforcement of the legislation on the dwelling information system
fi-he-62-2024.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending section 16 of the Act on the enforcement of the legislation on the apartment information system
fi-he-62-2024.t: Act amending section 16 of the Act on the enforcement of the legislation on the apartment information system

fi-he-62-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Foreign Law
fi-he-62-2025.s: According to point 10.3 (Immigration and Integration Policy) of the Government Programme, the government will tighten up the conditions for permanent residence, i.e. in practice a permanent residence permit and a long-term resident EU residence permit, in order to encourage integration and provide a vision of the future in Finnish society.

fi-he-62-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 34 of the Act on the Sustainability Criteria for Certain Fuels and the Emissions Trading Act
fi-he-62-2026.s: The aim of the proposal is to make the necessary amendments to national legislation required by the requirements and provisions for demonstrating conformity of low-carbon fuels in the Gas Market Directive.
fi-he-62-2026.t: amending section 34 of the Act on the Sustainability Criteria for Certain Fuels and the Emissions Trading Act

fi-he-63-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on legislation to promote distance access in general courts
fi-he-63-2024.s: The project provides for the participation of a judge and a party at a distance in general courts.
fi-he-63-2024.t: Legislation on promoting the use of distance access in legal proceedings before general courts

fi-he-63-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the entry into force of the Act amending the Act on Emergency Centre Activities
fi-he-63-2025.s: The transitional provision of the Emergency Centre Action Act would be amended so that section 10a of the Emergency Centre Action Act would enter into force on 28 June 2027, in accordance with the maximum timetable laid down in the Accessibility Directive.
fi-he-63-2025.t: Act amending the entry into force of the Act amending the Act on Emergency Centre Operations

fi-he-63-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on health services assisting in the detection of child-related suspected offences
fi-he-63-2026.s: Reform of the law on the organisation of the investigation of sexual assault and battery offences against children (1009/2008).
fi-he-63-2026.t: As a law on health services assisting in the detection of child-related suspected offences

fi-he-64-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 5 of Chapter 2c of the Criminal Code and the Act on the Processing of Personal Data at the Criminal Sanctions Agency
fi-he-64-2024.s: The amendment would apply to the system of conditional release of prisoners, with the aim of changing the rules so that only when the prisoner is sentenced to the first sentence of imprisonment, he can be released after performing a shorter amount of the sentence, and thus the so-called first-timeliness of the sentenced person would no longer be restored after a certain period of impunity.
fi-he-64-2024.t: Act amending section 5 of Chapter 2c of the Criminal Code and the Law on the Processing of Personal Data in the Criminal Sanctions Agency

fi-he-64-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the special financing activities of the State and its organisation and related laws
fi-he-64-2025.s: According to Orpo's Board of Directors programme, the project implements a comprehensive reform of Finnvera Corporation's legislation and strengthens Finnvera's role in supporting exports and its export promotion structures.
fi-he-64-2025.t: Law on the special financing activities of the State and its organisation and related laws

fi-he-64-2026.f: Draft legislation on coordination of invalidity pension and earnings in the Parliament of Finland
fi-he-64-2026.s: The aim is to prepare the necessary legislation to reconcile disability pension and earnings at work, which would replace the current provisions on the suspension of disability pension, which are contained in the law in force in force on time on the promotion of the return to work of persons on disability pension (738/2009).
fi-he-64-2026.t: Legislation on the coordination of invalidity pensions and earnings

fi-he-65-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending Section 3 of Chapter 25 of the Criminal Code
fi-he-65-2024.s: The aim of the project is to clarify the criminality of forced marriage in criminal law.
fi-he-65-2024.t: Act amending Section 3 of Chapter 25 of the Criminal Code

fi-he-65-2025.f: Draft laws of the Government amending and amending the Rail Transport Act and the Transport Services Act
fi-he-65-2025.s: Make changes to the Rail Transport Act and the Transport Services Act, as set out in the above paragraph, to the objectives and outputs.
fi-he-65-2025.t: Act amending and temporarily amending the Rail Transport Act and the Transport Services Act

fi-he-65-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend sections 14 and 17 of the Act on the Safety of Sportsmen and Men in Accidents and Pensions
fi-he-65-2026.s: The aim is to reform the Act on Accident and Pension Protection for Sportsmen (276/2009) as regards the organisation of old-age protection, which would also allow for the provision of old-age protection by means of an investment-linked pension insurance or, alternatively, of an occupational pension fund.
fi-he-65-2026.t: Act amending sections 14 and 17 of the Act on the Safety of Sportsmen's Accidents and Pensions

fi-he-66-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on Transport Services and related laws
fi-he-66-2025.s: According to Prime Minister Petteri Orpo's government programme, competition in passenger train transport is increased by enabling municipalities, joint municipal authorities and regions to organise the purchase of passenger train services. There is no statutory obligation in Finland to provide passenger train services and the initiative to organise regional passenger train transport would come from municipalities, joint municipal authorities or regions themselves.
fi-he-66-2025.t: Act amending the Transport Services Act and related laws

fi-he-66-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on legislation on the reform of the organisation and financing of ambulance and first-line transport and on changes in social and health care payments
fi-he-66-2026.s: The amendment of the Health Care Act, the Health Insurance Act and the Customer Charges Act, which includes, among other things, the transfer of financial responsibility for first-care transport to welfare areas, based on the Government's programme "Strong and caring Finland" and the spring 2024 framework decisions.
fi-he-66-2026.t: Legislative reform of the organisational and financial responsibility for ambulance and first-line care and changes in social and health care payments

fi-he-67-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending section 2 of the Act on the Promotion of Renewable Fuels in Transport and the Annex
fi-he-67-2025.s: The Government's proposal would implement Commission Delegated Directive (EU) 2024/1405, which added new raw materials to Annex IX to Directive (EU) 2018/2001 of the European Parliament and of the Council, proposing to amend the Annex to the Dissemination Obligations Act.
fi-he-67-2025.t: Amendment of section 2 of the Act on the Promotion of the Use of Renewable Fuels in Transport and the Annex

fi-he-67-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on Rehabilitation Benefits and Rehabilitation Benefits of the Social Insurance Institution and the Health Insurance Act, Chapters 15 and 17, and certain other laws
fi-he-67-2026.s: The procedural provisions of the legislation on benefits applied by the Social Insurance Institution would be harmonised, and the provision on the amount of the agreed unemployment benefit would be clarified, and the unemployment fund law would be amended so that its application from 1.5.26 onwards would be in line with the provision in force until 30 April 26 on the financing of benefits paid by the entrepreneurial fund.
fi-he-67-2026.t: Act amending Chapters 15 and 17 of the Act on Rehabilitation Benefits and Rehabilitation Benefits of the Social Insurance Institution and the Act on Health Insurance and certain other laws

fi-he-68-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Foreign Law
fi-he-68-2024.s: The project sets a ceiling of EUR 1600 on the residence permit of the worker and introduces a mandate for the adoption of a regulation which would in future provide for the income limit by a Council Regulation.

fi-he-68-2025.f: Draft legislation of the Government to the Parliament of Finland amending sections 2 and 11 of the Act on Certain Requirements for Dismantling Work, section 48 of the Law on the Supervision of Labour Protection and Cooperative Labour Protection at Work and the Act on Safety at Work
fi-he-68-2025.s: National implementation of Directive (EU) 2023/2668 of the European Parliament and of the Council, which expires on 21 December 2025, would be accompanied by a transfer of professional qualifications regulation on occupational safety tasks to the level of the law, and the introduction of authorisation provisions on the adoption of the Regulation in the Labour Safety Act.
fi-he-68-2025.t: Amendment of sections 2 and 11 of the Law on certain requirements for the dismantling of asbestos, section 48 of the Law on the supervision of health and safety at work and the Act on Safety at Work

fi-he-68-2026.f: Draft laws of the Government amending section 7b of the Disability Benefits Act, section 7b of the Social Insurance Act and section 2 of Chapter 10 and Chapter 11 of the Health Insurance Act
fi-he-68-2026.s: The urgent measures to improve access to social and health services in the government programme of Prime Minister Orpo will be reinstated, with emphasis on minors and lower income adults.
fi-he-68-2026.t: amending the Act on Disability Benefits, section 7b of the Act on Social Assistance and section 2 of Chapter 10 and Chapter 11 of the Health Insurance Act

fi-he-69-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Criminal Code and related laws
fi-he-69-2024.s: The criminalisation of female and female genital mutilation is more explicit in the Criminal Code, including the criminalisation of the export of a minor girl for genital mutilation. In the same context, section 4 of the Penal Code on the death of children in Chapter 21 is superfluous.
fi-he-69-2024.t: Law on the amendment of the Criminal Code and related laws

fi-he-69-2025.f: Draft laws of the Government amending the Act on the Authorisation of Interests and the Act on the Guardianship
fi-he-69-2025.s: To make the necessary amendments to the Act on Guardianship (442/1999) and to the Act on the Authorisation of Interests (648/2007) with a view to updating the regulatory framework.
fi-he-69-2025.t: amending the Act on Trustees and the Act on Guardianship

fi-he-69-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on Support for Home and Private Care
fi-he-69-2026.s: The project provides for the Norwegian model of home care support, i.e. a condition for three years' residence in Finland in order to obtain support for home care.
fi-he-69-2026.t: Act amending the Act on Support for Home and Private Care for Children

fi-he-7-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on housing savings system and related laws
fi-he-7-2025.s: The purpose of the housing savings scheme is to increase long-term housing savings and improve opportunities for first-time housing. The legislative work project will identify the needs for the development of ASP legislation and prepare a draft new legislation.
fi-he-7-2025.t: Act on housing savings and related laws

fi-he-7-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to temporarily amend the Act on the obligation storage of imported fuels
fi-he-7-2026.s: National implementation of the obligations of the EU Gas Storage Regulation.
fi-he-7-2026.t: on the temporary amendment of the Act on the obligation storage of imported fuels

fi-he-70-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the Financing of Welfare Areas
fi-he-70-2024.s: According to the government programme, in order to increase the incentive for the financing model, the ex post review of the funding at national level provides for a self-responsibility for welfare regions. The additional funding granted to individual regions will not be taken into account in the ex post review and will complement the regulation on taking account of changes in customer fees.
fi-he-70-2024.t: Act amending the Act on the Financing of Welfare Areas

fi-he-70-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending Chapter 8 of the Coercive Act
fi-he-70-2025.s: Review of the rules on the winding-up of the instrument search law (806/2011), taking into account the case-law of the Court of Justice of the European Union (C-548 / 21).
fi-he-70-2025.t: Act amending Chapter 8 of the Coercive Goods Act

fi-he-70-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a new law on territorial use and for the amendment of certain related laws
fi-he-70-2026.s: The aim is to modernise the territorial provisions for the implementation of the objectives of the Government Programme of Petteri Orpo. The new Regional Use Act consists of national provisions on territorial objectives, spatial planning and maritime spatial planning (planning of the use of the regions under Chapters 1-10a and 24-26a of the current Regional Use Act).
fi-he-70-2026.t: New territorial laws and laws amending certain related laws

fi-he-71-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending section 308 of the Act on the provision of digital services, section 308 of the Act on electronic communications services and section 18 of the Act on accessibility requirements for certain products
fi-he-71-2024.s: The purpose of the group is to establish a Directive of the European Parliament and of the Council on accessibility requirements for products and services (EU) 2019 / 882, which has been implemented nationally by law on accessibility requirements for certain products (102/2023) and by amendments to certain other laws which entered into force on 1 February 2023.
fi-he-71-2024.t: amending the Act on the provision of digital services, section 308 of the Act on Electronic Communications Services and section 18 of the Act on accessibility requirements for certain products

fi-he-71-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending Chapter 16 of the Criminal Code
fi-he-71-2025.s: criminalisation of so-called "blue-collar sabotage" to protect internal security authorities and emergency care staff, and the criminal code is amended to ensure that the penalty for violence against or threatened with emergency care staff is equivalent to the penalty for violent resisting of an official;
fi-he-71-2025.t: Act amending Chapter 16 of the Criminal Code

fi-he-71-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 17 of the Safety Investigation Act and the Cybersecurity Act
fi-he-71-2026.s: In accordance with the government programme record (p. 178), the possibility of adding safety investigations into serious cyber security incidents to the competence of the Accident Investigation Board will be examined. The Board of Directors will prepare, if necessary, legislative amendments to the Safety Investigation Act and will make any other necessary adjustments.
fi-he-71-2026.t: Act amending section 17 of the Safety Investigation Act and the Cybersecurity Act

fi-he-72-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the obligation of arms and the Act on the Voluntary Service of Women
fi-he-72-2025.s: The purpose of the working group envisaged would be to draw up a government proposal containing a proposal for the provisions necessary to allow for voluntary military service for Åland men.
fi-he-72-2025.t: amending the Act on the obligation of arms and the Act on the Voluntary Service for Women

fi-he-72-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on Nuclear Energy and Section 6 of Chapter 34 of the Criminal Code
fi-he-72-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending the Nuclear Energy Act; Act amending section 6 of Chapter 34 of the Criminal Code
fi-he-72-2026.t: Legislation amending section 6 of Chapter 34 of the Nuclear Energy Act and the Criminal Code

fi-he-73-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 16 of the Act on customer fees for early childhood education
fi-he-73-2025.s: The aim of the project is to amend the Act on customer fees for early childhood education so that the index used to revise early childhood education fees would be exchanged for the index of basic local government services. This would allow Statistics Finland to stop producing the index of educational services for the local government economy, which is now in use.
fi-he-73-2025.t: Act amending section 16 of the ECEC Act on customer fees

fi-he-73-2026.f: Presentation by the Government to the Parliament of Finland of the conclusion and implementation of the Agreement between the NATO Mission Management Headquarters and the NATO Transformation Management Command Executive Board of the Government of the Republic of Finland supplementing the Paris Protocol and related laws
fi-he-73-2026.s: At the General Session on 6 February 2025, the Government set up a negotiating delegation to negotiate a Protocol on the Status of International Military Staff set up under the North Atlantic Treaty (Treaty Series 25 and 26/2024, Paris Protocol) (SAA).
fi-he-73-2026.t: supplementing the Paris Protocol with a view to the adoption and implementation of the Agreement between the NATO Mission Management Headquarters of the Government of the Republic of Finland and the NATO Transformation Management Headquarters and the related laws

fi-he-74-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to facilitate the deployment of very high capacity networks, to amend sections 249 and 303 of the Act on Electronic Communications and to amend section 1 of the Law on the Enforcement of the fine
fi-he-74-2025.s: The project implements at national level the European Union's "Gigabit Infrastructure Act" (Regulation (EU) 2024/1309 of the European Parliament and of the Council on measures to reduce the costs of the deployment of the gigabit electronic communications networks, amending Regulation (EU) 2015/2120 and repealing Directive 2014 / 61 / EU).
fi-he-74-2025.t: Act facilitating the deployment of very high capacity networks, amending sections 249 and 303 of the Act on Electronic Communications Services and amending section 1 of the Law on the execution of the fine

fi-he-74-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the Promotion of Integration and related laws
fi-he-74-2026.s: The Government's proposal would reform integration services and amend the Act on the Promotion of Integration which entered into force on 1 January 2025.
fi-he-74-2026.t: amending the Act on the Promotion of Integration and related laws

fi-he-75-2025.f: Draft legislation of the Government to the Parliament of Finland amending sections 2 and 49 of the Code of Conduct, sections 19 and 28 of the Act on Voluntary National Defence and the Civil Service Act
fi-he-75-2025.s: The draft law is based on the recommendation of the Parliamentary Committee on Assurance (2021) to consider raising the upper reserve age, which led Prime Minister Orpo's Government to set the target in its programme to enable reservists and non-permanent military personnel to serve in the normal and exceptional circumstances of the defence forces.
fi-he-75-2025.t: As regards the law amending sections 2 and 49 of the Code of Armistice, sections 19 and 28 of the Act on Voluntary National Defence and the Civil Service Act

fi-he-75-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Environmental Protection Act
fi-he-75-2026.s: The amendment of Directive 2010 / 75 / EU of the European Parliament and of the Council on industrial emissions (hereinafter referred to as the Industrial Emissions Directive) (2024/1785) will be implemented by means of an amendment to the Environmental Protection Act, which expires on 1 July 2026.
fi-he-75-2026.t: Act amending the Environmental Protection Act

fi-he-76-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending Chapters 1 and 7 of the Accounting Act
fi-he-76-2024.s: The proposal proposes to amend the accounting law, which would implement the Commission's delegated Directive amending Directive 2013 / 34 / EU of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards changes to the limit values for the size classes of micro, small, medium and large enterprises or groups.
fi-he-76-2024.t: Act amending Chapters 1 and 7 of the Accounting Act

fi-he-76-2025.f: Draft law of the Government to the Parliament of Finland amending section 3 of the Digital and Population Information Agency Act and sections 5 and 25 of the Law on Public eGovernment Support Services
fi-he-76-2025.s: The Ministry of Finance has set up a legislative working group to prepare the prioritised amendments to the Ministry of Finance's sector of legislation necessary to implement or support the savings targets for the Agency's operational expenditure in 2025 and 2026.
fi-he-76-2025.t: Act amending section 3 of the Digital and Population Information Agency Act and sections 5 and 25 of the Law on Public Service Support Services for eGovernment

fi-he-76-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending section 86 of the Marriage Act
fi-he-76-2026.s: The aim of the proposal is to ensure the application of the previously adopted amendments to the Marriage Act as intended.
fi-he-76-2026.t: Act amending section 86 of the Marriage Act

fi-he-77-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the supervision and enforcement of the obligations of the EU Forest Destruction Regulation and related laws
fi-he-77-2025.s: The EU Forest Deforestation Regulation (EU) 2023/1115 was published on 9 June 2023, which aims to minimise the EU's contribution to global deforestation and forest degradation and to reduce the EU's contribution to greenhouse gas emissions and biodiversity loss.
fi-he-77-2025.t: Law on the supervision and enforcement of obligations under the EU Forest Destruction Regulation and related laws

fi-he-77-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the Prosecutor's Office and the Act on the National Information Reserve of the Judicial Administration
fi-he-77-2026.s: The project will, in the first phase, produce an evaluation memo to identify the needs for amending and continuing the legislation on the processing of personal data in the Public Prosecutor's Office and to provide an assessment of the most appropriate regulatory solution, and will then prepare a draft government proposal.
fi-he-77-2026.t: Act amending the Act on the Prosecutor's Office and the Law on the National Information Reserve of the judiciary

fi-he-78-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending sections 2 and 17 of the Act on the Welfare Area and on the organisation of social, health and rescue services in Uusimaa
fi-he-78-2024.s: The Board's proposal would cover changes in the regulation of the ex-ante management of welfare areas, economic guidance and the assessment process, as well as some other changes in the Welfare Area Act, as set out in the Government's programme.
fi-he-78-2024.t: amending sections 2 and 17 of the Act on the Welfare Area and on the organisation of social, health and rescue services in Uusimaa

fi-he-78-2025.f: Proposal of the Government to the Parliament of Finland for the adoption and entry into force of an extended framework agreement between the European Union and its Member States, of the one part, and the Republic of Chile, of the other part
fi-he-78-2025.s: The proposal proposes that the Parliament of Finland adopt an extended framework agreement signed between the European Union and its Member States, on the one hand, and the Republic of Chile, on the other hand, and a law transposing the provisions of the Treaty which are of a mixed nature, which includes the competences of both the Union and the Member States, on the other.
fi-he-78-2025.t: for the adoption and entry into force of an extended framework agreement between the European Union and its Member States, of the one part, and the Republic of Chile, of the other part

fi-he-78-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the VAT Act and the Act on derogations from the VAT and excise legislation in the Åland Islands
fi-he-78-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending the VAT Act; Act amending the VAT and excise legislation on derogations from the Åland Province
fi-he-78-2026.t: Act amending the VAT and excise legislation relating to derogations from the VAT and Åland Provinces Act

fi-he-79-2023.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on Electronic Communications Services
fi-he-79-2023.s: With the general charger provisions, the USB-C connector becomes mandatory for a wide range of radio devices, such as mobile phones, tablets, headphones, game consoles and portable loudspeakers.
fi-he-79-2023.t: Act amending the Act on Electronic Communications Services

fi-he-79-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the Treasury and to introduce a number of related laws
fi-he-79-2024.s: There is a need for legislative reform of the legislation governing the Treasury, and changes in the functions of the Treasury have taken place which make the legislation on the Treasury redundant and also the tasks and information rights of the Treasury necessary to be updated.
fi-he-79-2024.t: Act amending the Act on the Treasury and into a number of related laws

fi-he-79-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the entry into force of the Act amending the Accounting Act
fi-he-79-2025.s: The proposal provides for a law on large companies which have not yet been obliged to report on sustainability, which would allow for a two-year, 1 January 2027 and subsequent financial years to be deferred.
fi-he-79-2025.t: Act amending the entry into force provisions of the Act amending the Accounting Act

fi-he-79-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending the Act on the conditions of entry and residence of third-country nationals on the basis of research, studies, work placements and voluntary activities
fi-he-79-2026.s: The project implements the government programme on the withdrawal of a student's residence permit if the student relies on income support and on the use of ex post controls to effectively identify the use of income support.
fi-he-79-2026.t: amending the Act on the conditions of entry and residence of third-country nationals on the basis of research, studies, traineeships and voluntary activities

fi-he-8-2024.f: Presentation by the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland of legislation on the abolition of adult education aid, vocational qualification and rotation leave
